definition_zh: 每周的；每周一次的；周刊；周报；每周地
definition_en: happening, done, or published once every week, or a publication that appears every week
core_image: 翻到日历上每周固定圈出的那一天：同一格反复出现
scene: 编辑部每周五都要赶在同一截稿时间前付印。The editor finished the weekly magazine just before Friday's deadline.
sceneCN: 这里 weekly 是「周刊」（第 6 个义项：每周出版一次的刊物）；句意是编辑赶在周五截稿前完成了每周一期的杂志。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「周；星期」，weekly 由其加后缀 -ly 构成
同类构词，fortnight（两周）+ -ly，义为「每两周一次的」
同类构词，month（月）+ -ly，义为「每月的；月刊」
同类构词，year（年）+ -ly，义为「每年的；年刊」

senses.title: Happening once every week
senses.titleCN: 每周发生的；每周一次的
senses.definition: happening once every week or every seven days
senses.definitionCN: 每七天发生一次的，按周循环进行
senses.example: Our team has a weekly meeting every Monday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 我们团队每周一早上开一次例会。
senses.why: The base word week fixes the time unit, and -ly here forms an adjective of frequency, so the image is an event that returns with every new week.
senses.whyCN: 基础词 week 锁定了时间单位，-ly 在此构成表频率的形容词，意象是「每迎来新的一周，这件事就重现一次」。

senses.title: Calculated or paid by the week
senses.titleCN: 按周计算的；按周支付的
senses.definition: calculated, counted, or paid over a period of one week
senses.definitionCN: 以一周为单位来计算、统计或支付
senses.example: Workers here are paid a weekly wage instead of a monthly salary.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的工人拿的是周薪，而不是月薪。
senses.why: Once an event is tied to the week, money or figures measured over that span inherit the same weekly frame.
senses.whyCN: 当事情与「周」绑定后，按这一时段结算的金钱或数字自然沿用同一个「按周」的框架。

senses.title: Done or used every week as a routine
senses.titleCN: 每周例行使用的；每周进行的
senses.definition: used, done, or repeated as a weekly routine or habit
senses.definitionCN: 作为每周的例行安排被使用或重复
senses.example: She writes a weekly column for the local newspaper.
senses.exampleCN: 她为当地报纸撰写每周专栏。
senses.why: Repetition at fixed weekly intervals turns the adjective toward habitual practice rather than a single event.
senses.whyCN: 固定每周重复，使这个词从「一次性事件」转向「习惯性的例行做法」。

senses.title: Lasting or continuing for a week
senses.definition: lasting, continuing, or valid for the period of one week
senses.definitionCN: 为期一周、持续或有效一整周
senses.example: They rented a weekly apartment by the seaside for the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为度假在海边按周租了一套公寓。
senses.why: The week can measure not only a moment of return but also a span of duration, so weekly stretches to cover the whole seven days.
senses.whyCN: 「周」不仅能标记重现的时刻，也能度量持续的时段，weekly 于是可覆盖整整七天的跨度。

senses.title: Every week without exception
senses.definition: used to say that something happens each week as a matter of course
senses.definitionCN: 表示某事每周照例发生，无一例外
senses.example: The couple visits their parents weekly.
senses.exampleCN: 这对夫妇每周都去看望父母。
senses.why: As an adverb of frequency, weekly compresses the whole cycle into one word: each week, again and again.
senses.whyCN: 作为频率副词，weekly 把整个周期压缩进一个词里：每一周，一次又一次。

senses.title: A publication issued every week
senses.definition: a newspaper or magazine that is published once every week
senses.definitionCN: 每周出版一期的报纸或杂志
senses.example: This weekly focuses on science and technology news.
senses.exampleCN: 这本周刊聚焦科技新闻。
senses.why: When the adjective stands alone as a noun, it names the thing itself: the publication that reappears every week.
senses.whyCN: 当形容词独立成名词时，它直接指代事物本身：每周重现一次的那份出版物。

senses.title: A weekly event or series
senses.titleCN: 每周一次的活动（口语借代）
senses.definition: informal use for something that happens weekly, such as a regular gathering
senses.definitionCN: 口语中对每周固定发生之事的借代说法，如定期聚会
senses.example: Dinner at Grandma's became their weekly.
senses.exampleCN: 去奶奶家吃晚饭成了他们每周的固定活动。
senses.why: Like the magazine, a routine event can be reduced to the single word weekly, the frequency standing for the event itself.
senses.whyCN: 和周刊一样，例行活动也可以被压缩成 weekly 一个词，用频率代指活动本身。

senses.title: Weekly figures or records
senses.definition: recording or presenting data for each separate week
senses.definitionCN: 按每个独立星期记录或呈现数据
senses.example: The chart shows weekly rainfall for the whole summer.
senses.exampleCN: 图表显示了整个夏天每周的降雨量。
senses.why: Data sliced into seven-day units keeps the weekly label, extending from events to measurements.
senses.whyCN: 数据被切成七天一段的单位后沿用 weekly 标签，从事件扩展到度量。

intro.en: Weekly is a transparent compound of week plus the adverbial and adjectival suffix -ly, formed inside English rather than borrowed.
intro.cn: weekly 是 week（周）加后缀 -ly 的透明组合词，在英语内部生成，并非借词。

items.en: The root *weik- is generally reconstructed with senses of turning or changing, thought to underlie words for time cycles.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *weik- 含「转动、更替」之义，被认为是一系列时间循环词的基础。

items.en: Old English wicu or wice meant a period of seven days, already the calendar unit we still use.
items.cn: 古英语 wicu／wice 意为七天的时段，已是沿用至今的历法单位。

items.en: Middle English weke carried the same meaning, and compounds with -li began to mark frequency.
items.cn: 中古英语作 weke，词义不变，与 -li 组合的派生词开始表示频率。

items.en: Weekly is attested from the fifteenth century as an adjective meaning once every week, and later as an adverb.
items.cn: weekly 自十五世纪起有记载，作形容词表示「每周一次」，后来又用作副词。

items.en: The noun use for a weekly publication became common as periodical press grew in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪报刊业兴起后，指「周刊」的名词用法逐渐普遍。

items.en: Today weekly covers the adjective, adverb, and noun senses in everyday and professional language.
items.cn: 如今 weekly 兼作形容词、副词和名词，用于日常与专业语境。

note.en: Weekly sits in a family of frequency words built on time units with -ly, and is easily confused with the adverb weekly meaning weakly.
note.cn: weekly 属于「时间单位 + -ly」的频率词家族，且与表示「虚弱地」的 weakly 发音相近，需注意区分。

entries.definition: in a weak manner; lacking strength
entries.definitionCN: 虚弱地；无力地。与 weekly 只是发音相同，词源完全不同（weak + -ly）

entries.definition: happening or appearing once every month
entries.definitionCN: 每月一次的；月刊。构词方式与 weekly 完全平行
每年一次的；年刊。同为时间单位加 -ly 的频率词

entries.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the end of the week
entries.definitionCN: 周末。共享词根 week，但指时段而非频率
工作日的夜晚。同为 week 的复合词
定期的；规律的。泛指固定间隔，不限于一周

entries.definition: a magazine published at regular intervals
entries.definitionCN: 期刊；杂志。与周刊同类出版物，出版周期任意

entries.definition: every two weeks, or sometimes twice a week
entries.definitionCN: 两周一次的（有时指每周两次）。频率相邻，语义易混
每两周一次的（英式）。与 weekly 频率不同但同族
每日的；日报。更高频率的同族频率词

normalIntro.en: Weekly is easy to remember once you see week plus -ly and its frequency family.
normalIntro.cn: 看清 week 加 -ly 的结构以及整个频率词家族，weekly 就好记了。

normal.en: week + -ly: the suffix turns the time unit into a frequency word.
normal.cn: week（周）+ -ly：后缀把时间单位变成频率词。

normal.en: monthly, yearly, daily, fortnightly: one family of frequency words.
normal.cn: monthly、yearly、daily、fortnightly：同一个频率词家族。

normal.en: a weekly meeting returns every Monday.
normal.cn: weekly meeting 每周一都会回来一次。

normal.en: a weekly magazine has fifty-two issues a year.
normal.cn: 周刊一年出五十二期。

normal.en: weekly pay means your wallet is refilled every seven days.
normal.cn: weekly pay 意味着钱包每七天补一次。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar with the same square circled again and again, one week apart.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上同一格被反复圈出，每次相隔一周。

abstract.en: Hear a clock that chimes only on Fridays, the weekly signal.
abstract.cn: 听一座只在周五报时的钟，那就是每周一次的信号。

abstract.en: See pages of a magazine stacking up, one layer added every week.
abstract.cn: 看杂志一页页叠起来，每周加一层。

examples.en: The committee holds a weekly meeting to review progress.
examples.cn: 委员会每周开一次例会检查进展。

examples.en: Her weekly column is read by thousands of local residents.
examples.cn: 她的每周专栏被数千名当地居民阅读。

examples.en: He is paid weekly, every Friday afternoon.
examples.cn: 他按周领薪，每周五下午发放。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维克利」——维克每天都利索，但只有每周露面那天最「利」索，正好对应「每周一次」的频率感。

root: weekly 为英语本土构词：week（周，源自古英语 wicu「七天时段」，一般认为可追溯至原始印欧语词根 *weik-「转动、更替」）加副词／形容词后缀 -ly。此处 -ly 并非形容词「ly」的「像……一样」义，而是构词后缀，与 monthly、daily 同型。

sensesIntro.en: From the fixed seven-day cycle, weekly spreads from recurring events to pay, routines, duration, adverbial use, and finally the publication itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从固定的七天周期出发，weekly 由反复发生的事件扩展到薪酬、例行安排、持续时间、副词用法，最终落到出版物本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same point on the calendar returning every seven days
core.cn: 核心意象：日历上的同一点每七天重现一次

branches.en: recurring events harden into weekly routines
branches.cn: 反复发生的事件固化为每周例行安排

branches.en: money and data are sliced into weekly units
branches.cn: 金钱与数据被切成按周计算的单位

branches.en: the week measures duration, not just return
branches.cn: 周不仅标记重现，也度量持续时间

branches.en: as an adverb the whole cycle compresses into one word
branches.cn: 作副词时整个周期压缩进一个词

branches.en: the frequency itself names the publication and the event
branches.cn: 频率本身转而指代出版物和活动

intro.en: Weekly is built with the native suffix -ly attached to a Germanic time word, and its family shows the same pattern.
intro.cn: weekly 由本族语后缀 -ly 附加在日耳曼时间词上构成，其词族呈现相同构词模式。

latinIntro.en: As a Germanic formation, weekly has no Latin relatives; the entries below show the -ly pattern across time words.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼语构词，weekly 没有拉丁同源词；以下条目展示 -ly 在时间词上的构词模式。

items.meaningCN: 两周一次的（或每周两次的）
虚弱地；与 weekly 同音异源

definition_zh: 称重；权衡；斟酌；有分量；起锚
definition_en: to measure how heavy something is, or to consider something carefully before deciding
core_image: 双手托起天平：一端放物，一端放主意
scene: 法官闭卷沉思良久，才在两份证词间落笔。The judge paused for a long time to weigh the two conflicting statements.
sceneCN: 这里 weigh 是「权衡、斟酌」（第 4 个义项：仔细考量再作判断）；句意是法官停顿良久，在两份相互矛盾的证词之间仔细掂量。

pos.zh: 重达；有分量；具有重要意义

derivatives.zh: weigh 加名词后缀 -t（古英语尾音变化），义为「重量；权重」
weight + -y，义为「沉重的；重要的」
weight + -less，义为「失重的；无重量的」
over- + weight，义为「超重的」
under- + weight，义为「体重过轻的」

senses.title: To measure how heavy something is
senses.definition: to use scales or a balance to find out how heavy a person or thing is
senses.definitionCN: 用秤或天平测出人或物的重量
senses.example: The nurse weighs every newborn baby on the first day.
senses.exampleCN: 护士在第一天给每个新生儿称重。
senses.why: The original act is physical: putting an object on one side of a balance to read its heaviness.
senses.whyCN: 最初的动作是物理性的：把物体放上秤的一端，读出它有多重。

senses.title: To have a particular weight
senses.definition: to show a particular weight when measured
senses.definitionCN: 称量时显示某个具体重量
senses.example: The suitcase weighs less than two kilograms.
senses.exampleCN: 这只行李箱不到两公斤重。
senses.why: The measuring verb flips to the intransitive side: instead of weighing something, the thing itself weighs.
senses.whyCN: 称量动词翻转出不及物用法：不再是「称某物」，而是物自己「重多少」。

senses.title: To consider carefully before deciding
senses.definition: to think about the relative importance of facts or choices before making a decision
senses.definitionCN: 在决定前仔细考量各事实或选项的相对分量
senses.example: Before resigning, she weighed her options for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 辞职前，她把各种选择掂量了好几个星期。
senses.why: The balance in the mind mirrors the balance in the hand: ideas are placed against each other like objects.
senses.whyCN: 心中的天平映照手中的天平：各种想法像物件一样被两两放在秤上比对。

senses.title: To choose words with care
senses.definition: to choose each word carefully, being aware of its effect
senses.definitionCN: 字斟句酌，留意每个词的效果
senses.example: He weighed his words before answering the reporter.
senses.exampleCN: 回答记者前，他字斟句酌。
senses.why: Words gain metaphorical weight, so speaking carefully is weighing each one before it lands.
senses.whyCN: 词语有了隐喻性的「分量」，所以谨慎说话就是让每个词落下之前先称一称。

senses.title: To press down with burden or worry
senses.definition: to press on someone like a heavy load, usually with weigh on or weigh heavily
senses.definitionCN: 像重物压在人身上，常与 weigh on 或 weigh heavily 连用
senses.example: The exam results weighed heavily on his mind all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 整个夏天，考试结果都沉沉地压在他心头。
senses.why: Heavy things press down, so worries and duties are felt as literal weight on the shoulders or heart.
senses.whyCN: 重物会下压，忧虑与责任便被感受为压在肩头或心口的实重。

senses.title: To lift an anchor before sailing
senses.definition: to raise the anchor of a ship before it sails, in the phrase weigh anchor
senses.definitionCN: 开船前把锚从水底拉起，用于短语 weigh anchor
senses.example: The crew weighed anchor at dawn and headed for the open sea.
senses.exampleCN: 船员们黎明起锚，驶向大海。
senses.why: This is a historic separate sense: Old English wegan meant to carry or lift, so raising the heavy anchor is a natural extension.
senses.whyCN: 这是历史上的独立义项：古英语 wegan 本义为「搬运、抬举」，把沉重的锚拉起正是其自然延伸。

senses.title: To matter or count significantly
senses.definition: to have importance or influence in a decision or situation
senses.definitionCN: 在决定或局势中具有重要性或影响力
senses.example: His long experience weighs in any hiring decision.
senses.exampleCN: 无论哪次招聘，他的资历都很有分量。
senses.why: Importance is imagined as heaviness: what counts more literally weighs more on the scale of judgment.
senses.whyCN: 重要性被想象成重量：在判断的天平上，更有分量的东西自然「更重」。

senses.title: To be weighed down or burdened
senses.definition: to load or burden someone or something, usually in the passive with weigh down
senses.definitionCN: 使承受重负，常用于被动结构 weigh down
senses.example: The hikers were weighed down by heavy packs.
senses.exampleCN: 徒步者被沉重的背包压得直不起腰。
senses.why: The physical loading of weight becomes the model for any burden, physical or emotional.
senses.whyCN: 物理的载重成为一切负担的模型，无论是有形还是情绪上的。

intro.en: Weigh descends from a Germanic verb of carrying that split into two modern lines: one about heaviness and one about movement.
intro.cn: weigh 源自一个日耳曼语「搬运」动词，该动词在现代分化为两条线：一条关于重量，一条关于移动。

items.en: The root *wegh- meant to move or transport, especially by vehicle, and gave Latin vehere, the source of vehicle.
items.cn: 词根 *wegh- 意为「移动、运送」，尤指用车载运，并派生拉丁语 vehere（vehicle 的来源）。

items.en: The form *wegan meant to carry or bear weight on the move.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形式 *wegan 意为「搬运、负重而行」。

items.en: Old English had both wegan (to carry, lift) and a related noun wiht (weight, later weight).
items.cn: 古英语并存 wegan（搬运、举起）与同源名词 wiht（重量，后来成为 weight）。

items.en: The verb shifted from carrying to measuring heaviness, as weighing grain on scales became central to trade.
items.cn: 动词含义由「搬运」转向「称量」，因市集用秤称谷物成为交易核心。

items.en: The figurative sense of weighing arguments and words flourished in legal and rhetorical prose.
items.cn: 「权衡论据、斟酌词句」的比喻义在法律与修辞散文中兴盛。

items.en: Weigh now covers measurement, deliberation, burden, and the fixed nautical phrase weigh anchor.
items.cn: 如今 weigh 涵盖称量、斟酌、重负，以及固定航海短语 weigh anchor（起锚）。

note.en: Weigh looks like weight and sounds like way, and shares deep roots with words of movement and carrying.
note.cn: weigh 形似 weight，音同 way，且与「移动、运送」一词根的词汇关系深远。

entries.definitionCN: weigh 的过去式与过去分词，注意勿与 way 的形式混淆

考虑；细想。与「权衡」义相近，但不强调两相比对

entries.definitionCN: 权衡；使平衡。与 weigh 的核心意象同为天平

entries.definitionCN: 使负重；重担。对应 weigh down 的负担义

entries.definition: to judge the value or quality of something

normalIntro.en: Weigh becomes memorable through its silent letters, its twin weight, and the balance image.
normalIntro.cn: 通过不发音字母、孪生词 weight 和天平意象，weigh 变得好记。

normal.en: weigh has a silent gh, like weight and height.
normal.cn: weigh 中 gh 不发音，与 weight、height 一致。

normal.en: weigh + t = weight: add the t to get the noun.
normal.cn: weigh 加 t 就是 weight：加上 t 变成名词。

normal.en: weigh anchor: raise the heavy iron, start the journey.
normal.cn: weigh anchor：把沉重的铁锚拉起来，启航。

normal.en: weigh the pros and cons: put arguments on the two pans.
normal.cn: weigh the pros and cons：把论据放上天平两端。

normal.en: weigh one's words: every word is heavy, so drop them carefully.
normal.cn: weigh one's words：每个词都有分量，落地前先掂量。

abstract.en: Picture a scale in your head, ideas sliding onto each pan until one sinks.
abstract.cn: 想象脑中的天平，想法滑上秤盘，直到一边沉下去。

abstract.en: Feel worry as a stone in the chest, pressing down day and night.
abstract.cn: 把忧虑感受为胸中一块石头，日夜下压。

abstract.en: See a heavy anchor rising from dark water, ship ready to sail.
abstract.cn: 看沉重的锚从暗色的水中升起，船准备启航。

examples.en: The doctor weighs the baby at every check-up.
examples.cn: 医生每次体检都给婴儿称重。

examples.en: We must weigh the costs against the benefits.
examples.cn: 我们必须权衡成本与收益。

examples.en: Guilt weighed on her long after the argument.

sensesIntro.en: From putting goods on a scale, weigh spreads to the intransitive reading, mental deliberation, careful speech, emotional burden, the nautical lifting, and the weight of importance.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把货物放上秤出发，weigh 依次延伸到不及物读数、心里斟酌、谨慎措辞、情绪重负、航海起锚，以及重要性的分量。

branches.en: the physical act of weighing and the reading it produces
branches.cn: 称重的物理动作与由此读出的重量

intro.cn: weigh 本身无活用的前后缀，其结构最好通过日耳曼词根 *wegh- 及其派生词来观察。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词 vehere（载运）把 weigh 与整个「运送」词族联系起来。

definition_en: how heavy a person or thing is, or the force with which a body is pulled toward the ground
core_image: 秤盘上沉甸甸压下的那一格刻度
scene: 体检报告出来那天，他盯着数字沉默了。The doctor told him that his weight had increased by three kilograms.
sceneCN: 这里 weight 是「体重」（第 2 个义项：人或身体的重量）；句意是医生告诉他体重增加了三公斤。

senses.title: How heavy something is
senses.definition: the amount that a thing weighs, measured in units such as kilograms
senses.definitionCN: 物体有多重，以千克等为单位计量
senses.example: The bridge has a strict weight limit for trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥对卡车有严格的限重。
senses.why: The most direct sense: heaviness as a number read off the scale.
senses.whyCN: 最直接的义项：重量就是从秤上读出的那个数字。

senses.title: Body weight
senses.definition: the heaviness of a person's body, often watched for health
senses.definitionCN: 人的身体重量，常与健康相关而受关注
senses.example: She has been trying to lose weight since spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她从春天起一直在努力减肥。
senses.why: The general measure of heaviness attaches to the most personal object we carry: our own body.
senses.whyCN: 一般意义的「多重」附着到我们随身携带的最切身之物上：自己的身体。

senses.title: A heavy object
senses.definition: a piece of metal or other heavy material used to hold things down or on scales
senses.definitionCN: 用来压住东西或放在秤上的金属或其他重物
senses.example: Use paper weights to stop the map blowing away.
senses.exampleCN: 用镇纸压住地图，免得被风吹走。
senses.why: What is heavy can itself be made into an object: the measure becomes the tool.
senses.whyCN: 「重」的东西本身可以做成一件器物：度量之物变成了工具。

senses.title: Importance or influence
senses.definition: the importance, influence, or authority of a person, argument, or fact
senses.definitionCN: 人、论据或事实的重要性、影响力或权威性
senses.example: His opinion carries a lot of weight in the committee.
senses.exampleCN: 他的意见在委员会里很有分量。
senses.why: Heavy things sink the balance, so importance is felt as literal heaviness on the scale of judgment.
senses.whyCN: 重的一端会让天平倾斜，于是在判断的天平上，重要性被感受为实实在在的沉重。

senses.title: The downward force of gravity
senses.titleCN: 重力；地心引力作用的力
senses.definition: in physics, the force by which a body is pulled toward the earth
senses.definitionCN: 物理学中物体被拉向地面的力
senses.example: In orbit, astronauts experience almost no weight.
senses.exampleCN: 在轨道上，宇航员几乎感受不到重力。
senses.why: The everyday pull on everything is formalized by science as a measurable force.
senses.whyCN: 日常压着万物的下拉感被科学形式化为可测量的力。

senses.title: A burden or worry
senses.definition: a heavy load, or a worry that presses on the mind
senses.definitionCN: 沉重的负荷，或压在心头的忧虑
senses.example: The debt was a weight on his shoulders for years.
senses.exampleCN: 那笔债多年来一直压在他的肩头。
senses.why: Physical heaviness extends to anything that drags a person down, inside or outside.
senses.whyCN: 身体的沉重延伸到一切拖累人的事物，无论身内身外。

senses.title: The heaviest or hardest part
senses.definition: the largest share or most demanding part of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事中占比最大或最费力的部分
senses.example: The weight of the work fell on the new team.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分工作落在了新团队身上。
senses.why: When a load is shared, the heaviest share is called the weight of it.
senses.whyCN: 当负担被分担时，最重的那一份就被称为整件事的「重量」。

senses.title: To add weight or bias to something
senses.definition: to make a statistic, system, or object heavier or biased toward one side
senses.definitionCN: 使统计、系统或物体更重，或偏向一方
senses.example: The final score is weighted toward the written exam.
senses.exampleCN: 最终成绩向笔试倾斜（加大权重）。
senses.why: Adding literal weight tips a balance; adding figurative weight tips a system toward one side.
senses.whyCN: 加上实重会让天平倾斜，加上比喻的「重」则让系统向一方倾斜。

intro.en: Weight grew out of the same Germanic carrying verb as weigh, fixed into a noun by an old ending.
intro.cn: weight 与 weigh 同出一个日耳曼语「搬运」动词，经一个古老词尾固定为名词。

items.en: The root *wegh- meant to move or transport, especially by wheeled vehicle.
items.cn: 词根 *wegh- 意为「移动、运送」，尤指用车载运。

items.en: The noun *wihtiz is generally reconstructed as that which is carried or drawn.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼名词 *wihtiz 指「被搬运、被拖拽之物（的重量）」。

items.en: Old English wiht meant weight or amount, paired with the verb wegan (to carry).
items.cn: 古英语 wiht 意为「重量、分量」，与动词 wegan（搬运）相配。

items.en: Middle English weight absorbed a -t by analogy with words like might and light, reshaping the spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语在类推 might、light 等词后添入 -t，形成今天的拼写 weight。

items.en: The figurative sense of importance and influence became common in political and legal writing.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，「分量、影响力」的比喻义在政治与法律写作中普及。

items.en: Physics later fixed weight as the force of gravity on a mass, distinct from mass itself.
items.cn: 近代物理学将 weight 确立为质量所受的重力，与 mass 相区分。

note.en: Weight is twin to weigh in spelling history and is often mixed up with wait, which only shares the sound.
note.cn: weight 与 weigh 拼写史上是孪生词，又与只有读音相同的 wait 常被混淆。

normal.cn: pull one's weight：划桨时使出自己那份力气。

abstract.cn: 想象体重秤上的数字纹丝不动。

abstract.en: Feel a coin purse in each hand, one dragging the arm down.
abstract.cn: 两手各拎一个钱袋，一只手明显被拽得下沉。

abstract.en: See a courtroom balance tip when a famous expert speaks.
abstract.cn: 看法庭的天平在某位权威开口时倾斜。

examples.en: Check the weight of your luggage before the flight.
examples.cn: 登机前先称一下行李重量。

examples.en: Her advice carried real weight with the board.
examples.cn: 她的建议在董事会里很有分量。

examples.en: He lost weight by walking every evening.
examples.cn: 他靠每天晚上散步减了体重。

definition_zh: 怪异的；怪诞的；不寻常的；神秘而可怕的
definition_en: strange, unusual, or uncanny in a way that is hard to explain
core_image: 午夜里一件本该正常却微微走形的东西
scene: 旧宅的走廊尽头，挂钟在毫无风的时候自己摆动。A weird feeling came over her as the clock moved by itself.
sceneCN: 这里 weird 是「怪异而神秘的」（第 1 个义项：反常到难以解释）；句意是看到挂钟自己摆动，她涌起一种说不出的怪异感。

derivatives.zh: weird + -ly，义为「怪异地；不可思议地」
weird + -ness，义为「怪异；离奇」
weird + -o 口语后缀，义为「怪人」（带贬义）

senses.title: Strange and hard to explain
senses.definition: very strange and difficult to explain or understand
senses.definitionCN: 非常奇怪，难以解释或理解
senses.example: A weird light flickered in the empty hallway.
senses.exampleCN: 空荡的走廊里闪过一道怪异的光。
senses.why: The core image is something slightly wrong with the normal world, beyond a ready explanation.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是正常世界出现了说不清道不明的偏差，超出随手可得的解释。

senses.title: Uncanny or supernatural
senses.titleCN: 神秘而可怕的；有超自然色彩的
senses.definition: connected with fate or the supernatural, suggesting uncanny power
senses.definitionCN: 与命运或超自然相关，透着诡异的气息
senses.example: They met at midnight among the weird standing stones.
senses.exampleCN: 午夜时分，他们在那些诡异的立石间相会。
senses.why: This is the older sense preserved: the weird sisters of legend told fortunes, so weird keeps a taste of fate.
senses.whyCN: 这是保留下来的古义：传说中的「命运三姐妹」操持预言，weird 因此带着命运的余味。

senses.title: Unusual in an interesting way
senses.titleCN: 别致的；出人意表的新奇
senses.definition: unusual but attractive or interesting, often said of art or style
senses.definitionCN: 与众不同但有趣、有吸引力，常用于形容艺术或风格
senses.example: The gallery shows weird and wonderful sculptures.
senses.exampleCN: 这家画廊展出光怪陆离又妙趣横生的雕塑。
senses.why: Departure from the normal is not always frightening; it can delight, so weird turns positive in taste contexts.
senses.whyCN: 偏离常规未必可怕，也可能令人愉悦，于是在品味语境中 weird 转为褒义。

senses.title: Behaving strangely as a person
senses.definition: describing a person whose behavior others find odd
senses.definitionCN: 形容人的言行让他人觉得古怪
senses.example: He is a bit weird, but everyone likes him.
senses.exampleCN: 他有点古怪，但大家都喜欢他。
senses.why: A style or habit that breaks norms is read first as strangeness in the person.
senses.whyCN: 打破常规的作风或习惯，首先被解读为此人身上的「怪」。

senses.title: Feeling strange or unwell
senses.titleCN: 感觉不对劲的；不自在的
senses.definition: feeling odd, uncomfortable, or not normal, about the body or mood
senses.definitionCN: 身体或情绪感觉异常、不自在
senses.example: The medicine made her feel weird all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 那种药让她整个下午都感觉不对劲。
senses.why: When the self departs from its own normal, the same word for a strange world covers a strange feeling.
senses.whyCN: 当自我偏离了自身的常态，形容世界之怪的那个词便也覆盖了感觉之怪。

senses.title: Remarkably coincidental
senses.definition: so coincidental that it seems planned or uncanny
senses.definitionCN: 巧合到仿佛冥冥中安排好的地步
senses.example: It was weird that we both booked the same seat.
senses.exampleCN: 我们俩订了同一个座位，真是巧得出奇。
senses.why: Coincidence beyond chance feels like fate, linking back to the old sense of destiny.
senses.whyCN: 超出概率的巧合让人感到命运之手，正好接回古老的「命运」义。

senses.title: Weird weather or atmosphere
senses.definition: abnormal, said of weather, atmosphere, or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 形容天气、氛围或状况反常
senses.example: Weird weather hit the coast this winter.
senses.exampleCN: 今年冬天海岸边出现了反常天气。
senses.why: Nature off its usual rhythm produces the same unexplainable wrongness.
senses.whyCN: 自然偏离惯常节律时，同样呈现出那种说不清的反常。

senses.title: Weird as deliberate oddity
senses.definition: intentionally strange in design or performance
senses.definitionCN: 在设计或表演上故意追求怪诞
senses.example: The band is famous for its weird stage costumes.
senses.exampleCN: 这支乐队以刻意怪诞的舞台服装著称。
senses.why: Artists seize the uncanny on purpose, making strangeness a signature.
senses.whyCN: 创作者刻意抓取诡异感，把「怪」变成个人标志。

intro.en: Weird began as a noun of fate in Old English and shifted into today's adjective of strangeness.
intro.cn: weird 最初是古英语中的「命运」名词，后来才转变为今天表示「怪异」的形容词。

items.en: The root *wert- meant to turn, generally reconstructed as the source of the fate word.
items.cn: 一般认为其源头是意为「转动」的词根 *wert-，「命运」即「转动中落到身上之物」。

items.en: The form *wurthis meant that which turns, hence one's lot or destiny.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *wurthis 意为「转动之物」，引申为人的际遇或命运。

items.en: Old English wyrd meant fate or destiny, a person's appointed lot.
items.cn: 古英语 wyrd 意为「命运、定数」，指人被安排的际遇。

items.en: The noun survived in the weird sisters, the fate-spinning figures of legend and literature.
items.cn: 名词保留在传说中的「命运三姐妹」（weird sisters）里，即纺织命运的女巫形象。

items.en: From the fate-women came the adjective weird meaning uncanny or fateful, popularized by Shakespeare's witches.
items.cn: 由命运女巫生出形容词 weird「诡异、应验般的」，经莎士比亚笔下的女巫而流行。

items.en: The fate meaning faded and weird settled as the everyday word for strange and unexplainable.
items.cn: 「命运」义渐弱，weird 定型为日常表示「奇怪、难以解释」的词。

note.en: Weird is close to strange but adds an uncanny edge, and its spelling history links it to fate words.
note.cn: weird 与 strange 相近但更带一丝诡异，其拼写史又把它与「命运」一词相系。

abstract.en: Picture a clock swinging with no wind at midnight.
abstract.cn: 想象午夜无风时自己摆动的挂钟。

abstract.en: Feel the hair rise when a coincidence repeats twice.
abstract.cn: 巧合重复两次时，感到汗毛倒竖。

abstract.en: See three old women spinning one thread of life.
abstract.cn: 看三位老妇纺着一根命运之线。

examples.en: A weird noise came from the basement last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚地下室传来一阵怪声。

examples.en: It was weird how we arrived at the same idea at the same time.
examples.cn: 我们同时想到同一个点子，真是巧得出奇。

examples.en: She likes weird movies that break every rule.
examples.cn: 她喜欢那种打破一切规则的古怪电影。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威尔的」——威尔的朋友举止特别，「威尔的」朋友真怪。用「威尔的」谐音锚定 weird 的拼写与怪异义。

root: weird 源自古英语名词 wyrd「命运」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *wurthis「转动之物」（一般认为源自原始印欧语词根 *wert-「转动」），即「转落到人身上的际遇」。中古英语保留于 the weird sisters（命运三姐妹），十六世纪由「命运的」转为「诡异的」，最终定型为「怪异的」形容词。

sensesIntro.en: From its fate-spinning past, weird moves through uncanny strangeness, delightful oddity, odd people, odd feelings, strange coincidence, freak weather, and deliberate eccentricity.
sensesIntro.cn: 从纺织命运的过往出发，weird 依次经过诡异难解、新奇可喜、古怪之人、异常之感、离奇巧合、反常天气与刻意怪诞。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a familiar thing slightly bent out of shape in the dark
core.cn: 核心意象：熟悉之物在暗处微微走形

branches.en: the world itself looks wrong, from objects to weather
branches.cn: 世界本身显得不对劲，从器物到天气

branches.en: fate returns as uncanny coincidence and omen
branches.cn: 命运以诡异巧合与征兆的面目回归

branches.en: strangeness becomes a pleasure or a chosen style
branches.cn: 怪异变成趣味或刻意选择的风格

branches.en: the strangeness attaches to a person
branches.cn: 怪异附着到人身上，成为古怪

branches.en: the wrongness turns inward as a strange feeling
branches.cn: 不对劲转向内心，成为异常之感

intro.en: Weird is a single historical word without living affixes; its family comes from adding ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: weird 是一个无活用词缀的历史词，其词族由常规后缀派生而来。

definition_zh: 欢迎；迎接；受欢迎的；随意的；不客气的
definition_en: to greet someone arriving with pleasure, or pleasing and freely allowed
core_image: 推门时主人笑着迎上来的那一步
scene: 客人刚按响门铃，门就开了。Welcome! said the host, holding the door wide open.
sceneCN: 这里 welcome 是感叹词「欢迎」（第 7 个义项：见面时的招呼语）；句意是主人把门敞开说道「欢迎！」。

pos.zh: 受欢迎的；被允许的；尽管……好了

derivatives.zh: welcome 的现在分词形容词化，义为「热情好客的」
un- + welcome，义为「不受欢迎的」
同源构词（wel fare，安然远行），义为「福利；幸福」

senses.title: To greet an arrival with pleasure
senses.definition: to greet someone who arrives in a friendly or glad way
senses.definitionCN: 友好或喜悦地迎接到来的人
senses.example: The villagers welcomed the travelers with hot tea.
senses.exampleCN: 村民用热茶欢迎远来的旅人。
senses.why: The original image is wishing a comer well, so greeting is the verb's heart.
senses.whyCN: 本义是对来者「道一声安好」，问候便是这个动词的核心。

senses.title: To receive or accept gladly
senses.definition: to be pleased to receive news, help, or change
senses.definitionCN: 乐意接受消息、帮助或变化
senses.example: We welcome any suggestions to improve the course.
senses.exampleCN: 任何改进课程的建议我们都乐于接受。
senses.why: The glad greeting extends from people to ideas and events that arrive.
senses.whyCN: 喜悦的迎接从人扩展到「到来」的消息、主意与变化。

senses.title: Pleasing because wanted or needed
senses.definition: wanted, appreciated, or agreeable
senses.definitionCN: 被需要的、令人欣悦的
senses.example: The rain was a welcome break for the farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 这场雨对农民来说是可喜的缓解。
senses.why: What one would greet gladly is itself called welcome, the greeting frozen into a quality.
senses.whyCN: 人们乐于迎接之物本身就被称作 welcome，问候凝成了性质。

senses.title: Freely allowed to take or use
senses.definition: allowed or free to do or take something
senses.definitionCN: 获准做某事，或可随意取用
senses.example: You are welcome to any book on this shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 这个书架上的书你随便看。
senses.why: A host who wishes you well opens everything: the goodwill becomes permission.
senses.whyCN: 愿你安好的主人敞开一切：善意化作了许可。

senses.title: The polite reply to thanks
senses.definition: the polite answer to thank you, in you are welcome
senses.definitionCN: 对「谢谢」的礼貌回应，即「不客气」
senses.example: Thanks for the ride! You're welcome.
senses.exampleCN: 「谢谢载我一程！」「不客气。」
senses.why: You are welcome to my help means the help cost you nothing: welcome absorbs thanks.
senses.whyCN: 「欢迎使用我的帮助」意味着你不必回报：welcome 一词消化了谢意。

senses.title: The act or manner of being greeted
senses.definition: the way a person or thing is greeted or received
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物被迎接、被接待的方式
senses.example: The team got a warm welcome at the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 球队在机场受到了热烈欢迎。
senses.why: The verb's act is packaged as a noun: the greeting itself as an event.
senses.whyCN: 动词的动作被封装成名词：问候本身成为一件事。

senses.title: A greeting word to arrivals
senses.definition: used as a friendly cry or sign to greet someone arriving
senses.definitionCN: 用来招呼到来者的友好呼语或标牌用语
senses.example: A big sign above the gate read Welcome home!
senses.exampleCN: 大门上方的大牌子写着「欢迎回家！」。
senses.why: The full wish shortens to a single shouted word on signs and doors.
senses.whyCN: 完整的祝愿被压缩为门口与招牌上喊出的一个词。

senses.title: To welcome criticism or opposition
senses.titleCN: 对……泰然处之（反语或引申）
senses.definition: said of accepting something unwelcome boldly, often ironic
senses.definitionCN: 坦然接受不愉快之事，常带反语色彩
senses.example: Welcome to the world of unpaid overtime.
senses.exampleCN: 欢迎来到无偿加班的世界。
senses.why: Ironic use inverts the gladness: the greeting is a wry shrug at hardship.
senses.whyCN: 反语用法把喜悦倒转：这句「欢迎」是对苦境的苦笑耸肩。

intro.en: Welcome is a native compound meaning it is well that you come, built from wil- and cuma.
intro.cn: welcome 是本土复合词，本义为「你来得好（安然）」，由 wil- 与 cuma 构成。

items.en: The elements *wil- (wish, pleasure) and *kuman (to come) are generally reconstructed as the parts.
items.cn: 一般认为其构成成分是 *wil-（意愿、乐意）与 *kuman（来）。

items.en: Old English wilcuma meant a comer whose coming is wished for, both welcome guest and welcome thing.
items.cn: 古英语 wilcuma 指「来受欢迎之人」，兼指受欢迎的宾客与事物。

items.en: The spelling was remodeled after bien venu (well come) in medieval French usage.
items.cn: 中古拼写受法语 bien venu（来得正好）影响而改造。

items.en: Middle English welcome settled in spelling and covered guest, thing, and greeting alike.
items.cn: 中古英语 welcome 拼写定型，兼指宾客、事物与问候语。

items.en: The verb to welcome someone and the reply you are welcome expanded in Early Modern English.
items.cn: 十六世纪前后，动词「欢迎某人」与答语 you are welcome 在早期现代英语中扩展开来。

items.en: Today welcome works as verb, adjective, noun, and interjection in every register.
items.cn: 如今 welcome 兼作动词、形容词、名词与感叹词，通用于各种语域。

note.en: Welcome hides the same well- as welfare and weld, and is often confused in spelling with welcome vs welcom.
note.cn: welcome 中藏着与 welfare、weld 相同的 wel-（安好），拼写上则常与误写 welcom 混淆。

热情好客的。welcome 的形容词化分词

焊接。一般认为与 well（好）的古老词形同源（存疑）

entries.definition: to say hello or welcome to someone
entries.definitionCN: 问候；打招呼。泛指见面招呼，不含喜悦之情

entries.definition: to accept an idea or change gladly
entries.definitionCN: 欣然接受（比喻义）。对应 welcome 的接受义

entries.definition: to welcome or accept someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 接待；接受。中性词，语气弱于 welcome

entries.definition: friendly and generous reception of guests
entries.definitionCN: 好客；款待。对应 welcome 的名词接待义
问候语。对应感叹词用法的一般说法

normalIntro.en: Welcome breaks neatly into well plus come, which is the whole story.
normalIntro.cn: welcome 整齐地拆成 well + come，这就是它的全部故事。

normal.en: well + come: your coming is well, good, wished for.
normal.cn: well + come：你来得好，受欢迎。

normal.en: You're welcome answers Thank you.
normal.cn: You're welcome 回应 Thank you。

normal.en: welcome news: news you would greet with open arms.
normal.cn: welcome news：让人张开双臂迎接的消息。

normal.en: welfare and welcome share wel, meaning good.
normal.cn: welfare 与 welcome 共享 wel（好）。

normal.en: outstay your welcome: the welcome runs out of time.
normal.cn: outstay your welcome：欢迎会过期，待久遭嫌。

abstract.en: Picture a door swung wide and a host stepping forward.
abstract.cn: 想象门被整个推开，主人迎上前来。

abstract.en: Feel warm tea pressed into your cold hands on arrival.
abstract.cn: 感受刚进门就被塞进手里的热茶。

abstract.en: See a welcome mat lying flat before the door.
abstract.cn: 看门口平放的那块 welcome 门垫。

examples.en: They welcomed the delegates at the conference hall.
examples.cn: 他们在会议厅迎接代表们。

examples.en: Any help you can offer would be welcome.
examples.cn: 你能提供的任何帮助都受欢迎。

examples.en: Welcome to our new office building!
examples.cn: 欢迎来到我们的新办公楼！

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为而卡姆」——为你而来而「come」，来了就是客，欢迎欢迎。用「来得好」的画面绑定 well + come。

root: welcome 为古英语本土复合词 wilcuma「受欢迎的来者」，由 wil-/wel-（意愿、安好，与 well 同源）+ cuma（来者，与 come 同源）构成；中古拼写受法语 bien venu 影响定形。同族词有 welfare（wel + fare「安好远行」）。

sensesIntro.en: From wishing a guest well, welcome grows into glad acceptance, wanted qualities, open permission, the reply to thanks, the greeting event, the cry of greeting, and ironic entry into hardship.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对宾客道安出发，welcome 长出欣然接受、可喜之质、开放许可、答谢用语、迎接场面、招呼呼语，以及苦境面前的反语开门词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opened wide with a smile before the guest knocks
core.cn: 核心意象：客人未敲门，主人已笑着把门敞开

branches.en: the greeting as action and as event
branches.cn: 问候既是动作，也是一场接待

branches.en: ideas and events are greeted like guests
branches.cn: 想法与事件像宾客一样被迎接

branches.en: goodwill becomes permission to take freely
branches.cn: 善意化为随意取用的许可

branches.en: the wish of well-being absorbs the thanks of others
branches.cn: 安好之愿消化了他人的谢意

branches.en: the greeting becomes a cry, then an ironic shrug

definition_en: the health, happiness, and comfort of a person or group, or money paid by the state to people in need
core_image: 远方行路之人被盼着一路安好
scene: 社区中心门口排起了长队，人们等着领取补助。The new program aims to improve the welfare of low-income families.
sceneCN: 这里 welfare 是「福利」（第 4 个义项：政府提供的补助与保障）；句意是新计划旨在改善低收入家庭的福利。

pos.zh: 福利；幸福；福祉；社会保障

derivatives.zh: welfare 的两个构成成分：wel（安好）+ fare（出行、境况）
同族构词，fare + well，义为「再见；愿你一路安好」
近义复合词，义为「安康；幸福感」

senses.title: Health, happiness, and comfort
senses.definition: the general health, happiness, and comfort of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体总体的健康、幸福与安逸
senses.example: Parents put the welfare of their children first.
senses.exampleCN: 父母把孩子的幸福安康放在第一位。
senses.why: The old wish of a good journey broadened into a general state of faring well.
senses.whyCN: 古时「一路安好」的祝愿，扩展为「过得好」的总体状态。

senses.title: Care for the well-being of others
senses.definition: attention to making sure someone is safe, healthy, and all right
senses.definitionCN: 确保他人安全、健康无恙的关心与照管
senses.example: The teacher reported her concern for the child's welfare.
senses.exampleCN: 老师表达了对那个孩子福祉的担忧。
senses.why: If faring well is a state, looking after it becomes a duty of care.
senses.whyCN: 「过得好」是一种状态，守护这种状态便成为照管之责。

senses.title: Organization for animal or child welfare
senses.definition: organized efforts to protect animals, children, or other vulnerable groups
senses.definitionCN: 保护动物、儿童等弱势群体的有组织行动
senses.example: She volunteers at an animal welfare society.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一家动物保护协会做志愿者。
senses.why: Care for the weak becomes an institution with its own name and flag.
senses.whyCN: 对弱者的照管结成机构，拥有自己的名义与旗帜。

senses.title: State aid to people in need
senses.definition: money and services given by the government to people who are poor, ill, or unemployed
senses.definitionCN: 政府向贫困、患病或失业者提供的金钱与服务
senses.example: After losing his job, he lived on welfare for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 失业后，他靠救济金生活了两年。
senses.why: When the state takes over the old duty of care, its payments inherit the word welfare.
senses.whyCN: 当国家接过旧的照管之责，它的补助金便沿用了 welfare 这个词。

senses.title: The welfare system itself
senses.definition: the whole set of public programs that support citizens' basic needs
senses.definitionCN: 保障公民基本需求的整套公共制度
senses.example: Debates about reforming the welfare system never end.
senses.exampleCN: 关于改革福利制度的争论从未停止。
senses.why: Individual aid adds up to a system, and the system takes the name of its purpose.
senses.whyCN: 一项项补助汇成制度，制度便以其目的命名。

senses.title: Personal benefit or interest
senses.definition: what is best for a person's interests, as in decisions made for someone's welfare
senses.definitionCN: 就某人利益而言的最佳安排
senses.example: The court decides custody based on the child's welfare.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭根据孩子的利益来裁决抚养权。
senses.why: Faring well narrows again to whatever arrangement serves one person best.
senses.whyCN: 「过得好」又收窄为对某个人最有利的安排。

senses.title: Welfare as collective prosperity
senses.definition: the shared well-being of a whole society or nation
senses.definitionCN: 整个社会或国家共享的安康
senses.example: Economic growth should serve the welfare of all citizens.
senses.exampleCN: 经济增长应服务于全体公民的福祉。
senses.why: The same good state is measured over a whole people, becoming a goal of politics.
senses.whyCN: 同样的好状态被放大到整个民族头上，成为政治的目标。

senses.title: Welfare officer or worker
senses.definition: used in job titles for those who look after others' well-being
senses.definitionCN: 用于照顾他人福祉的岗位名称
senses.example: The school appointed a student welfare officer.
senses.exampleCN: 学校任命了一名学生福利干事。
senses.why: Institutions attach the word to the person who performs the care.
senses.whyCN: 机构把这个词安到执行照管的那个人头上。

intro.en: Welfare is a native compound of well and fare, literally faring well, with no Latin or French borrowing involved.
intro.cn: welfare 是 well 与 fare 的本土复合词，字面即「过得好」，不含拉丁或法语借词。

items.en: *wel- meant well or wish, and *faran meant to travel or go on a journey.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 *wel- 意为「好、愿」，*faran 意为「出行、行进」。

items.en: Wel and faran existed separately; the compound wel faran meant to fare well, to get along fine.
items.cn: 古英语 wel 与 faran 各自独立；组合 wel faran 意为「过得好、顺遂」。

items.en: The compound welfare is attested from about the fourteenth century, still meaning good fortune or happiness.
items.cn: 复合词 welfare 约于十四世纪见诸文献，仍指好运或幸福。

items.en: Welfare expanded to organized care, founding welfare societies and welfare work.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪，welfare 扩展到有组织的关怀，出现福利社团与福利工作。

items.en: The modern sense of government aid crystallized with the welfare state after the Second World War.
items.cn: 二战后随「福利国家」兴起，政府救济的现代义定型。

items.en: Welfare now spans personal happiness, public aid, and animal protection alike.
items.cn: 如今 welfare 兼指个人幸福、公共救助与动物保护。

note.en: Welfare shares its two native parts with well-being, farewell, and welcome, and is often swapped loosely with benefit.
note.cn: welfare 的两个本土成分也出现在 well-being、farewell、welcome 中，日常又常与 benefit 混用。

abstract.en: See a queue at the community center collecting aid forms.
abstract.cn: 看社区中心里排队领取补助表格的人们。

abstract.en: Feel the calm of knowing someone looks after you.
abstract.cn: 感受有人照管你的那份安心。

examples.en: The charity works for the welfare of homeless children.
examples.cn: 这家慈善机构为无家可归儿童的福祉而工作。

examples.en: Unemployment welfare kept the family going that winter.
examples.cn: 那年冬天，失业救济金撑起了这个家。

examples.en: Laws on animal welfare have grown stricter.
examples.cn: 动物福利方面的法律日趋严格。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维尔费」——维尔一家生活遇困难，政府「费」心补贴，这就是「福利」。用「国家费心保障」绑定救济义。

root: welfare 为古英语本土复合词，由 wel（好、安好，well 的古老形式）+ faran（出行、过日子）构成，本义「过得好、顺遂」。同族词 farewell（fare + well，「一路安好」，用作送别语）。十四世纪定型为名词，二十世纪随福利国家制度获得「政府救济」义。

sensesIntro.en: From faring well on a journey, welfare grows into personal happiness, duty of care, protection societies, state aid, the whole system, individual best interest, collective prosperity, and care job titles.
sensesIntro.cn: 从旅途顺遂出发，welfare 长出个人幸福、照管之责、保护事业、国家救济、整套制度、个人最佳利益、公共福祉与照管岗位名义。

branches.cn: 「好状态」既指人的幸福，也指其最佳利益

branches.cn: 守护这种状态成为职责与岗位

branches.cn: 照管之责组织起来，保护弱者

branches.en: the state pays and builds the system of aid

branches.en: the good state is scaled up to a whole society
branches.cn: 好状态被放大到整个社会

intro.cn: welfare 由两个本土词复合而成，其词族展示 wel- 与 fare 在英语中的组合方式。

latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼复合词，welfare 没有拉丁同源词，拉丁条目留空。

definition_en: in a good or satisfactory way; a deep hole dug for water; in good health; a word used to pause in speech
core_image: 一枚深井从大地里舀出清水，也是话语开头的清嗓一声
scene: 村口的老井旁，人们排着队打水闲聊。The villagers drew clean water from the old stone well.
sceneCN: 这里 well 是名词「井」（第 5 个义项：地下取水的深洞）；句意是村民从古老的石井里打出清水。

well + being 复合词，义为「安康」

senses.title: In a good or satisfactory way
senses.definition: in a good, skillful, or successful manner
senses.definitionCN: 以好的、熟练的或成功的方式
senses.example: She sings well enough to perform on stage.
senses.exampleCN: 她唱得相当好，足以登台演出。
senses.why: The oldest adverb: whatever is done to a wished-for standard is done well.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的副词用法：凡是达到预期水准的事，就是做得「好」。

senses.title: In good health
senses.definition: healthy; not ill
senses.definitionCN: 身体健康的，没生病的
senses.example: I hope you get well soon after the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 希望你手术后早日康复。
senses.why: Faring well applies first to the body, so healthy and well became twins.
senses.whyCN: 「过得好」最先落在身体上，healthy 与 well 遂成孪生。

senses.title: Thoroughly or to a great degree
senses.definition: to a great degree or extent, often before prepositions or adjectives
senses.definitionCN: 程度深，常置于介词短语或形容词前
senses.example: The thief was well ahead of the police by dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 到天亮时，窃贼早已远远甩开了警察。
senses.why: A thing done well has reached its mark completely, so well stretches to mean fully.
senses.whyCN: 做得「好」意味着完全到位，well 由此引申为「充分、远远」。

senses.title: A word to pause or resume speech
senses.definition: used to pause, change subject, or express surprise in conversation
senses.definitionCN: 会话中用来停顿、转换话题或表达惊讶
senses.example: Well, I never expected to see you here!
senses.exampleCN: 哎呀，真没想到会在这儿见到你！
senses.why: Speech needs a soft step before a new thought; well is that step.
senses.whyCN: 说话转入新念头前需要一个缓冲，well 就是那声缓冲。

senses.title: A deep hole dug for water or oil
senses.definition: a deep hole dug or drilled into the ground to obtain water or oil
senses.definitionCN: 为取水或石油而挖、钻的深洞
senses.example: The farm has its own well behind the barn.
senses.exampleCN: 农场谷仓后面有一口自家的井。
senses.why: The good thing the earth gives up is gathered in one place: the hole itself is named for the blessing.
senses.whyCN: 大地赐予的「好东西」聚在一处：取好物之洞便以「好」得名。

senses.title: A source or reserve that can be drawn on
senses.definition: an abundant source of something, such as knowledge or emotion
senses.definitionCN: 某种事物（如知识、情感）的丰富来源
senses.example: She drew on a deep well of patience that day.
senses.exampleCN: 那天她动用了深不见底的耐心储备。
senses.why: The water hole becomes a metaphor: inside a person, too, lies something to draw up.
senses.whyCN: 水井化为隐喻：人的内心同样藏着可以汲起的东西。

senses.title: To well up or burst out
senses.definition: to rise to the surface like water from a well, used of tears or feelings
senses.definitionCN: 像井水涌出般上涌，用于泪水或情绪
senses.example: Tears welled up in his eyes at the reunion.
senses.exampleCN: 重逢时，他眼中涌起泪水。
senses.why: The noun turns verb: what lies deep rises up the shaft to the light.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：深处之物沿井筒升到光亮处。

senses.title: Sensible, wise, or fortunate
senses.definition: used to say something is wise, right, or fortunate, as in it is well that
senses.definitionCN: 表示明智、得体或幸运，用于 it is well that 结构
senses.example: It is well that you arrived before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 幸好你赶在暴风雨前到了。
senses.why: What matches the wished-for standard is not only done well but judged well.
senses.whyCN: 合乎预期的不只是做得好，还被评判为「得当、有幸」。

intro.en: The two wells of English, the adverb and the water hole, come from different ancient roots that crossed in spelling.
intro.cn: 英语中的两个 well——副词与水井——出自不同古词根，却在拼写上交汇。

items.en: The adverb comes from *wel-, generally reconstructed as wishing or willing; the noun from *kʷel-, to turn, hence a rotating digging tool.
items.cn: 副词一般认为出自表「意愿」的 *wel-；名词出自表「转动」的 *kʷel-（转动挖土成洞）。

items.en: *wel- gave the wish adverb; *hwalaz or similar gave the pit sense in Germanic speech.
items.cn: *wel- 派生表意愿的副词；日耳曼语中另一支形式派生出「坑洞」义。

items.en: Old English wel meant well or very, while wiell or well meant a spring or water hole.
items.cn: 古英语 wel 意为「好、很」，wiell／well 则指泉眼或水坑。

items.en: Middle English kept both wells, and their spellings converged into one form.
items.cn: 中古英语保留两个 well，拼写逐渐合流为一个形式。

items.en: The oil well sense arose with early drilling, and the metaphorical well of feelings appeared in literature.
items.cn: 十六世纪后钻井兴起，油井义出现；情感之「井」的隐喻进入文学。

items.en: Today well is among the most frequent English words, working as adverb, adjective, noun, and filler.
items.cn: 如今 well 是最高频的英语词之一，兼任副词、形容词、名词与口语填充词。

note.en: The adverb well and the water well are homonyms of different roots, and well is easily confused with will in fast speech.
note.cn: 副词 well 与水井 well 是异根同形词，快速语流中 well 又易与 will 混淆。

entries.definitionCN: 膨胀；长浪。与 well 拼写相近但词根不同

normal.en: well, better, best: the irregular ladder of good.
normal.cn: well、better、best：good 的不规则阶梯。

normal.en: well done means both praise and fully cooked meat.

normal.en: as well = too; also.
normal.cn: as well = 也、同样。

normal.en: a well holds water; a well of courage holds bravery.
normal.cn: 井蓄水，勇气之「井」蓄胆量。

normal.en: Well, ... is how English speakers buy thinking time.
normal.cn: Well,…… 是英语母语者争取思考时间的口头禅。

abstract.en: Hear a rope creak as a bucket rises from deep water.
abstract.cn: 听辘轳吱呀，水桶从深井升起。

abstract.en: Feel warm relief after the doctor says you are well.
abstract.cn: 听医生说「你好了」，如释重负。

abstract.en: See someone pause mid-story and start again with Well...
abstract.cn: 看讲故事的人顿一顿，用 Well 重新开口。

examples.en: The team played well and won the match.
examples.cn: 球队表现出色，赢了比赛。

examples.en: They dug a well to water the fields.
examples.cn: 他们挖了一口井来灌溉田地。

examples.en: Well, let's see what the results say.
examples.cn: 那么，看看结果怎么说吧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维尔」——维尔做什么都做得「well（好）」，家后院还有口 well（井）。同音双义一起记。

root: well 有两个来源：副词／形容词义出自古英语 wel「好、合意」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *wel-（意愿，与 will 同根，一般认为源自原始印欧语 *wel-）；水井／源泉义出自古英语 wiell「泉眼」，一般认为源自原始印欧语词根 *kʷel-「转动」（转动挖具成洞）。两词中古拼写合流为一个 well。

sensesIntro.cn: 副词一线从「做得好」到健康、程度、口语停顿与庆幸；名词一线从水洞到内心源泉与涌动的情绪。

core.cn: 核心意象：一口深井，从中汲起好东西

branches.en: good manner stretches into full degree
branches.cn: 好的方式延伸为充分的程度

branches.cn: 「过得好」同时评判身体与际遇

definition_zh: 西；西方；西部；向西的；在西方的；向西
definition_en: the direction where the sun goes down, or the western part of a country or the world
core_image: 太阳每天沉落的那一端天空
scene: 傍晚时分，一家人站在田埂上望着落日。The farmer pointed west as the sun sank behind the hills.
sceneCN: 这里 west 是名词「西方」（第 1 个义项：日落的方向）；句意是农民指着太阳沉入山后的西方。

pos.zh: 向西的；在西边的；西方的

senses.title: The direction of the setting sun
senses.definition: the direction on the left when facing north, where the sun sets
senses.definitionCN: 面朝北时的左手方向，即日落之处
senses.example: The house faces west, so evenings are bright.
senses.exampleCN: 房子朝西，傍晚很亮堂。
senses.why: The daily death of the sun fixes the most ancient landmark of direction.
senses.whyCN: 太阳每日的沉落，钉下了最古老的方位坐标。

senses.title: The western part of a country or region
senses.definition: the part of a country or area that lies toward the west
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区偏西的部分
senses.example: Heavy rain is expected in the west of the country.
senses.exampleCN: 预计该国西部有大雨。
senses.why: From a compass point, the word grows into a territory with weather and life of its own.
senses.whyCN: 从罗盘的一点长成一片有天气、有生活的地域。

senses.title: Europe and North America as a bloc
senses.definition: Europe and North America, especially as a political or cultural group
senses.definitionCN: 欧洲与北美，尤指作为政治或文化阵营
senses.example: The leaders of the West met to discuss trade.
senses.exampleCN: 西方各国领导人会晤商讨贸易。
senses.why: From one's homeland, everything further toward the sunset blurred into the far West.
senses.whyCN: 从故土望去，日落方向尽头的世界模糊成遥远的「西方」。

senses.title: Toward or situated in the west
senses.definition: lying toward, facing, or moving toward the west
senses.definitionCN: 朝西的、面向西的或向西移动的
senses.example: A west wind brought rain all night.
senses.exampleCN: 一夜西风带来了雨水。
senses.why: The noun leans into adjective use: anything directed at that point of sky takes its name.
senses.whyCN: 名词倾斜出形容词用法：凡朝向天空那一点的事物都以它命名。

senses.title: Moving or facing westward
senses.definition: in a direction toward the west, used of travel or position
senses.definitionCN: 朝着西的方向，用于行进或位置
senses.example: The birds flew west for the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟儿们向西飞去过冬。
senses.why: Direction becomes motion: the word tracks the mover instead of the place.
senses.whyCN: 方位化为运动：词跟着移动者走，而不是停在原地。

senses.title: The American West of pioneer times
senses.definition: the western United States, especially in the frontier period
senses.definitionCN: 美国西部，尤指拓荒时代
senses.example: Westerns tell stories of cowboys in the Old West.
senses.exampleCN: 西部片讲述旧西部牛仔的故事。
senses.why: In American history, one direction's name became a whole age and myth.
senses.whyCN: 在美国史里，一个方位的名称化作整个时代与神话。

senses.title: The western end of a city or town
senses.definition: the west side of a city, often with its own character
senses.definitionCN: 城市的西侧，常自成一格
senses.example: Most of the theaters are in the West End.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数剧院都在西区（伦敦西区）。
senses.why: Cities inherit the compass: their halves live under the same old directions.
senses.whyCN: 城市继承了罗盘：城区的两半仍活在古老的方位名下。

senses.title: The west wind or its effects
senses.definition: wind blowing from the west, often bringing changeable weather
senses.definitionCN: 从西面吹来的风，常带来多变天气
senses.example: The west will bring milder air by the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 到周末，西面将送来更温和的空气。
senses.why: Weather reporters treat directions as actors that carry wind and rain.
senses.whyCN: 气象播报把方位当作携风带雨的「行动者」。

intro.en: West is an ancient Germanic direction word, generally linked to a root about evening and dwelling.
intro.cn: west 是古老的日耳曼方位词，一般认为与「黄昏、栖居」相关的词根有联系。

items.en: The root *wes- meant to dwell or pass the evening, generally reconstructed as the source.
items.cn: 一般认为源头是意为「栖居、过夜」的词根 *wes-（太阳在黄昏「歇息」之处）。

items.en: The form *westraz named the direction of the setting sun.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *westraz 命名日落的方向。

items.en: Old English west served as noun, adjective, and adverb, as it still does.
items.cn: 古英语 west 已兼作名词、形容词与副词，沿用至今。

items.en: Norse vestr reinforced the word in northern dialects during the Viking age.
items.cn: 维京时代古诺斯语 vestr 在北方方言中加固了该词。

items.en: The political sense of the West as a civilization bloc emerged in European writings.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，作为文明阵营的「西方」概念见于欧洲文献。

items.en: American history added the frontier West, and geography kept every other use.
items.cn: 美国史添入拓荒西部的专名义，地理用法悉数保留。

note.en: West belongs to the compass family of north, south, and east, and is spelled close to waist and rest.
note.cn: west 属 north、south、east 方位词家族，拼写上又近 waist、rest。

abstract.cn: 感受车队朝地平线滚滚西行。

abstract.cn: 看罗盘针停在左手指向的一端。

examples.en: Drive west for two miles and turn left.
examples.cn: 向西开两英里然后左转。

examples.en: The west of the island has the best beaches.
examples.cn: 该岛的西部有最好的海滩。

examples.en: A strong west wind flattened the wheat.
examples.cn: 强劲的西风把麦子吹伏了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维斯特」——太阳走到最「西」头就「没了斯特（了）」，西边即日落之处。

root: west 源自古英语 west「西」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *westraz，一般认为出自原始印欧语词根 *wes-「栖居、过夜」（日落之处即太阳「歇息」之地）。同族方位词 east（日出处）、north、south。十七世纪起衍生出「西方文明阵营」的政治文化义。

sensesIntro.en: From the sunset point, west expands to regional geography, the Western bloc, adjective and adverb uses, the American frontier, city districts, and the west wind of the forecast.
sensesIntro.cn: 从日落之点出发，west 依次扩展到区域地理、西方阵营、形容词与副词用法、美国拓荒西部、城市西区与气象里的西风。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the sky where the sun goes down every day
core.cn: 核心意象：太阳每日沉落的那片天空

branches.en: the direction works as noun, adjective, and adverb
branches.cn: 方位本身兼任名词、形容词与副词

branches.en: the direction becomes land: region and district
branches.cn: 方位化为土地：大区与城区

branches.en: the far west becomes a civilization bloc
branches.cn: 日落尽头的世界化为文明阵营

branches.en: one direction names an age of pioneers
branches.cn: 一个方位之名冠于整个拓荒时代

branches.en: the direction turns into moving weather
branches.cn: 方位化作流动的天气

intro.en: West builds its family with the direction suffixes -ern and -ward and the compass compounds.
intro.cn: west 借方位后缀 -ern、-ward 及罗盘复合词构建词族。

latinIntro.en: As a Germanic word, west has no Latin relatives; the formal Latin cousin occident is listed separately.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼词，west 无拉丁同源词；正式的拉丁对应词 occident 单独列出。

western 派生，义为「西方人」

definition_zh: 西方的；西部的；向西的；西部片；西方人（形容词名词化）
definition_en: lying toward, relating to, or characteristic of the west; a film about the American West
core_image: 落日染红的地平线上，牛仔剪影缓缓前行
scene: 小镇影院正在重映一部老片。The western movie showed cowboys riding across the desert.
sceneCN: 这里 western 是名词「西部片」（第 5 个义项：以美国西部为题材的电影）；句意是这部西部片放映牛仔驰骋沙漠的画面。

pos.zh: 西部片；西部小说；西方人

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「西；西方」，western 由其加 -ern 构成
western + -er，义为「西方人；西部人」
western + -ize，义为「使西方化」
western + -most，义为「最西端的」

senses.title: Lying in or toward the west
senses.definition: situated in, toward, or facing the west
senses.definitionCN: 位于西部、朝向西边
senses.example: We sailed along the island's western coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿岛的西海岸航行。
senses.why: The direction word takes -ern to become a shape of land: which side something stands on.
senses.whyCN: 方位词加 -ern 化为土地的形貌：某物立在天空的哪一侧。

senses.title: Of the western part of a country
senses.definition: belonging to the western region of a country or area
senses.definitionCN: 属于一个国家或地区的西部
senses.example: The western provinces grow most of the wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 西部省份出产大部分小麦。
senses.why: The compass point draws a region around itself, with products and people.
senses.whyCN: 罗盘上的一点为自己圈出一方水土，连同物产与人。

senses.title: Of Europe and North America
senses.definition: relating to the cultures of Europe and North America
senses.definitionCN: 与欧美文化相关的
senses.example: Western ideas of law shaped the new constitution.
senses.exampleCN: 西方法治观念塑造了新宪法。
senses.why: The sunset direction hardened into a cultural label for a whole civilization.
senses.whyCN: 日落方位固化为整个文明的标签。

senses.title: Characteristic of western style
senses.definition: having the style, dress, or customs of the West
senses.definitionCN: 具有西式风格、服饰或习俗
senses.example: The hotel serves both western and local breakfasts.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店同时供应西式和本地早餐。
senses.why: A civilization's label narrows to tables, clothes, and habits.
senses.whyCN: 文明的标签缩小到餐桌、衣着与日常习惯上。

senses.title: A film or story of the American West
senses.definition: a book or movie about cowboys and the frontier American West
senses.definitionCN: 关于牛仔与美国拓荒西部的电影或小说
senses.example: Grandpa loves old westerns with horse chases.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷爱看有骏马追逐场面的老西部片。
senses.why: The adjective stands alone and names a whole genre by its setting.
senses.whyCN: 形容词独立成名词，用故事发生地命名整个类型。

senses.title: A person from the west
senses.definition: a person who lives in or comes from the west or Western world
senses.definitionCN: 居住在西部或来自西方世界的人
senses.example: The village had seen few westerns before that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年之前，村里很少见到西方人。
senses.why: As with the film, the adjective names the person by their compass home.
senses.whyCN: 如同影片一样，形容词以罗盘上的故乡来指代人。

senses.title: Western medicine or science
senses.definition: medicine, science, or education as practiced in Western countries
senses.definitionCN: 西方国家实行的医学、科学或教育体系
senses.example: He chose western medicine over traditional treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 他选择西医而非传统疗法。
senses.why: The cultural label attaches to professional systems of knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 文化标签附着于专业化的知识体系之上。

senses.title: The western wind or side in nature
senses.definition: describing natural features on the west side, such as slopes or winds
senses.definitionCN: 形容位于西侧的自然物，如坡地、风向
senses.example: The western slopes get the evening light.
senses.exampleCN: 西坡沐浴在傍晚的光线里。
senses.why: Geography borrows the compass word for its own ends.
senses.whyCN: 地理学借罗盘之词为自己所用。

intro.en: Western is west with the old direction suffix -ern, the same ending seen in northern and southern.
intro.cn: western 是 west 加古老的方位后缀 -ern，与 northern、southern 中的词尾相同。

items.en: The base root *wes- is generally linked to dwelling or the evening of the day.
items.cn: 一般认为基础词根 *wes- 与「栖居、黄昏」相关。

items.en: *westraz named the sunset direction in the Germanic parent language.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 *westraz 命名日落方向。

items.en: Old English westerne is attested, built as west + the -erne direction suffix.
items.cn: 古英语已有 westerne 的记载，结构为 west + 方位后缀 -erne。

items.en: Middle English western settled into the modern spelling, covering sides and winds.
items.cn: 中古英语 western 拼写定型，用于方位与风向。

items.en: The civilization sense spread with European colonial contact and scholarship.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪，随欧洲殖民接触与学术交流，「西方文明」义扩散。

items.en: American cinema made the noun western a worldwide genre name.
items.cn: 二十世纪美国电影使名词 western 成为世界性的类型片名称。

note.en: Western pairs with eastern in the compass set and is often confused with the noun west and the spelling westerly.
note.cn: western 与 eastern 在方位词族中成对，又常与名词 west 及拼写相近的 westerly 混淆。

entries.definition: toward or from the west, used of winds
entries.definitionCN: 向西的；西来的（多用于风向）。后缀 -ly 与 -ern 之别
西方人。western 加 -er 的派生

entries.definition: to make something Western in style
entries.definitionCN: 使西方化。western 加 -ize
东方的。与 western 同后缀的成对方位词
西风（气象术语）。western 与 westerly 的气象分工

entries.definition: of the West, formal or literary
entries.definitionCN: 西方的（正式）。拉丁词源的对应形容词
牛仔片。western 名词义的通俗说法
欧洲的。与「西方的」义有重叠但不重合
向西（移动）。侧重运动而非属性
西方（名词）。正式对应词

normalIntro.en: Western is remembered as west plus ern, beside its compass twins.
normalIntro.cn: 把 western 记作 west + ern，与方位词孪生兄弟并排记。

normal.en: west + -ern: the direction suffix, like northern.
normal.cn: west + -ern：方位后缀，同 northern。

normal.en: the West End, Western Europe, the Wild West.
normal.cn: 西区、西欧、狂野西部，都是 west 的固定专名。

normal.en: a western means a cowboy movie.
normal.cn: a western 就是指牛仔片。

normal.en: western medicine versus traditional medicine.
normal.cn: 西医与传统医学相对。

normal.en: westerner: a person ending with -er.
normal.cn: westerner：加 -er 的「人」。

abstract.en: Picture a cowboy silhouette against a red sunset.
abstract.cn: 想象红色落日映出的牛仔剪影。

abstract.en: See a fork beside chopsticks on one hotel table.
abstract.cn: 看酒店餐桌上刀叉与筷子并排。

abstract.en: Feel the evening sun warm the western slope.
abstract.cn: 感受西坡上傍晚的暖阳。

examples.en: Western companies dominate that market.
examples.cn: 西方公司主导着那个市场。

examples.en: They watched an old western last night.
examples.cn: 他们昨晚看了一部老西部片。

examples.en: The western shore is quieter in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天，西岸更清静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维斯顿」——太阳走到西边便「斯顿（停）」住，西部的日子在日落时停格，正如西部片的镜头。

root: western 由 west（古英语 west「西」，一般认为源自原始印欧语词根 *wes-「栖居、黄昏」）加古英语方位后缀 -erne（今 -ern，与 northern、southern 同型）构成。古英语已有 westerne，文明阵营义与「西部片」名词义均为后期发展。

sensesIntro.en: From a side of the map, western grows into regions, a civilization, style labels, the cowboy genre, Western people, Western science, and natural slopes.
sensesIntro.cn: 从地图的一侧出发，western 长出区域、文明、风格标签、牛仔类型片、西方人、西学与自然坡地诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: land and people colored by the setting sun
core.cn: 核心意象：被落日染色的土地与人烟

branches.en: the compass side describes land and nature
branches.cn: 罗盘的一侧描述土地与自然

branches.en: the side becomes an administrative region
branches.cn: 一侧化为行政区

branches.en: the far side becomes a civilization and its sciences
branches.cn: 遥远一侧化为文明及其知识体系

branches.en: civilization shrinks into everyday style
branches.cn: 文明缩小为日常风格

branches.en: the label names a genre and its people
branches.cn: 标签转而命名类型片与人群

intro.en: Western is the model of the -ern direction suffix, and its family extends with -er, -ize, and -most.
intro.cn: western 是 -ern 方位后缀的范例，其词族再经 -er、-ize、-most 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin parallel is occidens, the setting; the English line stays Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁平行词是 occidens（日落之处）；英语一线保持日耳曼血统。

derivatives.zh: western 派生，义为「西方人」
western 派生，义为「使西方化」
westernize 派生，义为「西方化」

definition_zh: 什么；多么；何等；……的事物；所……的
definition_en: used to ask for information about a thing, or to emphasize a statement
core_image: 一只手指向未知之物，等待世界给出名字
scene: 盲盒摆在桌上，弟弟猜不出里面是什么。What is inside the box, he kept asking everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 what 是疑问词「什么」（第 1 个义项：询问事物名称或内容）；句意是他不停地问大家盒子里装的是什么。

derivatives.zh: what + ever，义为「无论什么；任何事物」
what + so + ever，义为「任何（强调）」
some + what，义为「有点；稍微」
同族疑问词，义为「为什么」

senses.title: Asking for a thing or fact
senses.definition: used to ask for the name, nature, or details of something
senses.definitionCN: 询问某物的名称、性质或细节
senses.example: What is your favorite subject at school?
senses.exampleCN: 你在学校最喜欢的科目是什么？
senses.why: The pointing hand of language: when the thing is unknown, what asks the world to name it.
senses.whyCN: 语言伸出的一根手指：事物未知时，what 请世界给出名字。

senses.title: The thing or things that
senses.definition: the thing or things that, introducing a noun clause
senses.definitionCN: 引导名词性从句，义为「……的东西／事情」
senses.example: Show me what you wrote yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 把你昨天写的东西给我看看。
senses.why: The unknown point becomes a package: all that you did, sealed in one word.
senses.whyCN: 未知之点打包成一个整体：你做过的一切，装进一个词里。

senses.title: Asking about kind or degree
senses.definition: used before a noun to ask about type, size, or nature
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，询问类型、大小或性质
senses.example: What color would you like the room painted?
senses.exampleCN: 你想把房间漆成什么颜色？
senses.why: The hand still points, but now it asks for a label among many.
senses.whyCN: 手指仍在指，但这回是在众多标签中索要一个。

senses.title: Emphasizing a good or striking quality
senses.definition: used to give force to a statement about something impressive
senses.definitionCN: 加强语气，表示事物了不起或惹眼
senses.example: What a wonderful view from this tower!
senses.exampleCN: 这座塔上的景色真美啊！
senses.why: When the thing is known but astonishing, the question word turns into applause.
senses.whyCN: 事物已知却令人惊叹，疑问词于是变成了一声喝彩。

senses.title: Expressing surprise or shock
senses.definition: used as a cry of surprise or disbelief
senses.definitionCN: 表示惊讶或不信的呼语
senses.example: What! You sold the car without telling me?
senses.exampleCN: 什么！你没告诉我就把车卖了？
senses.why: The pointing hand jerks back: the answer is too strange to be believed.
senses.whyCN: 指向的手猛然缩回：答案怪到令人难以置信。

senses.title: Used to suggest or offer
senses.definition: used to make a suggestion, as in what about or how about
senses.definitionCN: 用于提建议，如 what about 结构
senses.example: What about a short break before the next chapter?
senses.exampleCN: 下一章之前稍微休息一下怎么样？
senses.why: The question softens into an invitation: name the thing and see if others nod.
senses.whyCN: 疑问化柔为邀请：说出那个东西，看看别人是否点头。

senses.title: Asking for a reason or purpose
senses.definition: used to ask about purpose, especially in what for
senses.definitionCN: 询问目的，尤其用于 what for
senses.example: What did you buy that old ladder for?
senses.exampleCN: 你买那架旧梯子干什么用？
senses.why: Beyond naming the thing, the question digs into why the thing exists.
senses.whyCN: 在给事物命名之外，追问它为何存在。

senses.title: In whatever, no matter what
senses.definition: used in concessive phrases meaning regardless of what happens
senses.definitionCN: 用于让步短语，义为「不管发生什么」
senses.example: Come what may, we will finish the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 无论发生什么，我们都会把桥修完。
senses.why: The unknown is accepted in advance: whatever comes, the plan holds.
senses.whyCN: 未知被预先接纳：无论来的是什么，计划照旧。

intro.en: What descends from an ancient interrogative stem that also gave who, whom, and whose.
intro.cn: what 源自古老的疑问词干，who、whom、whose 也出自同一家族。

items.en: The stem *kʷo- formed question words across many old languages, generally reconstructed as the source.
items.cn: 一般认为疑问词干 *kʷo- 是众多古语言疑问词的源头。

items.en: The stem became *hwat, keeping the hw- sound of the question family.
items.cn: 词干变为日耳曼语 *hwat，保留疑问家族的 hw- 读音。

items.en: Old English hwæt meant what or why, serving as pronoun and adverb.
items.cn: 古英语 hwæt 意为「什么、为何」，兼任代词与副词。

items.en: Spelling changed from hw- to wh- under Norman scribal habits, giving what.
items.cn: 受诺曼抄写习惯影响，拼写由 hw- 改为 wh-，形成 what。

items.en: The exclamatory use, as in What a day!, flourished in drama and poetry.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，What a day! 式的感叹用法在戏剧与诗歌中盛行。

items.en: What now spans questions, clauses, exclamations, and suggestions in everyday speech.
items.cn: 如今 what 覆盖疑问、从句、感叹与提议，通行于日常口语。

note.en: What heads a question family that includes which, who, and why, and its spelling was reshaped from hwæt.
note.cn: what 领衔一个疑问词家族，包括 which、who、why，其拼写又由 hwæt 改造而来。

谁。同族疑问词，问人

entries.definitionCN: 引导内容已知的从句；what 引导内容未知的从句

normalIntro.en: What is remembered through its question family and its famous phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 通过疑问词家族和著名短语来记 what。

normal.en: what, which, who, why, when, where: the question six.
normal.cn: what、which、who、why、when、where：疑问词六兄弟。

normal.en: what if = imagine that possibility.

abstract.cn: 看一只手指向未拆的盒子。

abstract.en: Hear a gasp at an unbelievable answer.
abstract.cn: 听到对难以置信回答的一声抽气。

abstract.en: Feel the thrill before a blindfold taste test.
abstract.cn: 感受蒙眼试吃前的兴奋。

examples.cn: 关于郊游，老师说了什么？

examples.cn: 她现在需要的是好好休息。

examples.en: What a mess the children made in the kitchen!
examples.cn: 孩子们把厨房弄得真乱啊！

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沃特」——沃特总是满脸问号：这「沃特（什么）」？用名字的疑问脸绑定 what。

root: what 源自古英语 hwæt，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hwat、原始印欧语疑问词干 *kʷo-（同族词 who、whom、whose、why 等）。中古英语受诺曼书写习惯影响由 hw- 改拼为 wh-。感叹用法与从句用法在早期现代英语中充分发展。

sensesIntro.en: From pointing at the unknown, what serves questions, packed clauses, kind-questions, exclamations, surprise, suggestions, purposes, and concessive whatever.
sensesIntro.cn: 从指向未知出发，what 依次承担疑问、打包从句、类别提问、感叹、惊讶、提议、目的与让步结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing at something with no name yet
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指指向尚无名字之物

branches.en: the question asks for names and kinds
branches.cn: 疑问索取名称与类别

branches.en: the unknown is packed into clauses and purposes
branches.cn: 未知被装进从句与目的问句

branches.en: astonishment flips into applause
branches.cn: 惊愕翻转为喝彩

branches.en: the pointing hand jerks back in shock
branches.cn: 指向之手因震惊猛然缩回

branches.en: the question softens into offers and concessions
branches.cn: 疑问软化成提议与让步

intro.en: What compounds freely with ever and other words to build its whole family.
intro.cn: what 与 ever 等词自由复合，构建出整个词族。

latinIntro.en: The same Indo-European stem gave Latin quod and quis, cousins of what across languages.
latinIntro.cn: 同一印欧词干派生了拉丁语 quod、quis，是 what 的跨语言表亲。

derivatives.zh: what 派生，义为「无论什么」
what 强调派生，义为「任何」
what 口语复合，义为「诸如此类之物」

definition_zh: 全部的；整个的；完整的；未受伤的；整体；全部
definition_en: complete, with no part missing; the entire amount or thing
core_image: 一只完好的碗：没有缺口，一片一片都在
scene: 搬家清点时，奶奶坚持数齐每一只茶碗。The old bowl was whole after all these years.
sceneCN: 这里 whole 是形容词「完整的；未破损的」（第 3 个义项：无缺损）；句意是这么多年过去，那只旧碗依然完好无损。

pos.zh: 全部的；完整的；未破损的

derivatives.zh: whole + -ly，义为「完全地；整个地」
whole + -ness，义为「完整；圆满」
whole + -some，义为「有益健康的」
whole + sale 复合词，义为「批发」

senses.title: Including every part; entire
senses.definition: including all the parts of something; not divided or partial
senses.definitionCN: 包含某物所有部分，未被分割或只取局部
senses.example: The whole family gathered for the New Year dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 全家团聚吃年夜饭。
senses.why: The image is a circle with nothing cut away: every piece is still in place.
senses.whyCN: 意象是一个没有被切走任何一块的圆：每一片都还在原位。

senses.title: Complete after being broken or divided
senses.definition: not broken into pieces; kept or put together as one
senses.definitionCN: 没有碎裂；保持或恢复为一体
senses.example: The plate stayed whole despite the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 盘子摔了下去却完好无损。
senses.why: What survives without losing a piece is praised as whole.
senses.whyCN: 经历跌落而未少一块者，被称为完好。

senses.title: Uninjured; healthy
senses.definition: physically sound or healthy, with no injury
senses.definitionCN: 身体健全、无伤无病
senses.example: The climber came back whole after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 事故之后，登山者完好归来。
senses.why: Body and object share the measure: a missing part is damage in both.
senses.whyCN: 身体与器物共用同一把尺：缺一块即损。

senses.title: A complete unit regarded by itself
senses.definition: a thing considered as one complete unit, not as separate parts
senses.definitionCN: 被视为一个完整单位的事物，而非零散部件
senses.example: The parts cost little, but the whole is priceless.
senses.exampleCN: 零件不值钱，但整体无价。
senses.why: When pieces are counted, the noun steps back to name what they add up to.
senses.whyCN: 当人们清点零件时，名词退后一步，为零件之和命名。

senses.title: More than expected; emphasized amount
senses.definition: used to stress a surprisingly large amount or duration
senses.definitionCN: 强调数量或时间之多之大，超出预期
senses.example: We waited a whole hour before the train came.
senses.exampleCN: 我们整整等了一个小时火车才来。
senses.why: Every single part present makes the total feel heavy, so whole becomes an exclamation of amount.
senses.whyCN: 一块不缺让总量显得沉甸甸，whole 便成了数量的惊叹。

senses.title: General impression across details
senses.definition: mostly or generally, in the phrase on the whole
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 on the whole，表示大致而言
senses.example: On the whole, the trip went smoothly.
senses.exampleCN: 总的来说，这次旅行很顺利。
senses.why: Standing back from the parts, the whole view smooths the bumps.
senses.whyCN: 从零件处抽身远望，整体视野抚平了坑洼。

senses.title: Not cut or refined; natural
senses.titleCN: 未加工的；全然的（whole grain 等）
senses.definition: kept in its natural state, not processed or refined
senses.definitionCN: 保持天然状态，未经加工精炼
senses.example: Whole grain bread keeps more fiber.
senses.exampleCN: 全谷物面包保留更多纤维。
senses.why: Nothing milled away means nothing valuable lost.
senses.whyCN: 没有磨掉的部分，也就没有损失的价值。

senses.title: Entirely; completely (adverb)
senses.definition: completely, used informally as an adverb
senses.definitionCN: 口语中作副词，表示完全地
senses.example: The fish was swallowed whole by the heron.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼被苍鹭囫囵吞下。
senses.why: The adjective leans into the verb: the act treats the thing as one piece.
senses.whyCN: 形容词倒向动词：动作把对象当作一整块对待。

intro.en: Whole is the surviving form of an ancient adjective that also gave the verb to hale, and it is a cousin of heal and health.
intro.cn: whole 是一个古老形容词的存留形式（曾派生动词 hale），并与 heal、health 是表亲。

items.en: The root *kailo- meant whole, uninjured, and of good omen, generally reconstructed as the source.
items.cn: 一般认为词根 *kailo- 意为「完整的、未受伤的、吉兆的」。

items.en: The form *hailaz meant entire and safe, giving many Germanic health words.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hailaz 意为「完整的、平安的」，派生出多个日耳曼健康词。

items.en: Old English hal meant whole, healthy, and unhurt, as in hale and hearty.
items.cn: 古英语 hal 意为「完整的、健康的、无伤的」，即 hale 一词的来源。

items.en: Spelling split: whole took a w- by Scandinavian influence, while hale kept the older form.
items.cn: 受斯堪的纳维亚影响，拼写添 w- 而成 whole；hale 保留旧形。

items.en: The noun use, the whole versus the parts, grew in philosophy and science writing.
items.cn: 十六世纪，「整体对部分」的名词用法在哲学与科学写作中生长。

items.en: Whole now spans amounts, health, food, and everyday emphasis.
items.cn: 如今 whole 覆盖数量、健康、食品与日常强调。

note.en: Whole is cousins with heal, health, and hale, and is famously confused with its sound-twin hole.
note.cn: whole 与 heal、health、hale 是表亲，又与同音的 hole 是著名的混淆点。

entries.definitionCN: 洞；孔。与 whole 同音异源，意义几乎相反

entries.definition: strong and healthy, especially of older people
entries.definitionCN: 健壮的（尤指老人）。whole 的古形亲族

entries.definition: to make a wound whole again
entries.definitionCN: 治愈。同根动词，使伤口复归完整
健康。同根名词，即「完整无缺」的状态
完全地。whole 的副词
整个的；全部的。与 whole 义近，更书面
完整的；齐全的。强调各部分俱在
总的；总额。侧重数字加总
完好无损的。强调经历之后未损

entries.definition: the state of being whole and unbroken
entries.definitionCN: 完整；正直。whole 名词义的正式对应

normalIntro.en: Whole is remembered through its health family and the famous hole pair.
normalIntro.cn: 通过健康词族和与 hole 的著名对子来记 whole。

normal.en: whole has a w, hole digs a hole: whole keeps everything, hole keeps nothing.
normal.cn: whole 有 w，hole 挖洞：whole 什么都在，hole 什么都不留。

normal.en: whole, health, heal, hale: one ancient family.
normal.cn: whole、health、heal、hale：一个古老家族。

normal.en: on the whole = generally speaking.
normal.cn: on the whole = 总的来说。

normal.en: a whole hour is longer than an hour feels.
normal.cn: a whole hour 听起来比一小时更漫长。

normal.en: swallow it whole: take it as one piece.
normal.cn: swallow it whole：囫囵吞下，整块接受。

abstract.en: Hold a perfect bowl with no chip anywhere.
abstract.cn: 捧一只哪儿都没有缺口的完碗。

abstract.en: Feel a wound closing until skin is smooth.
abstract.cn: 感受伤口愈合，皮肤重新平整。

abstract.en: See jigsaw pieces turning into one picture.
abstract.cn: 看拼图碎片拼成一幅完整的画。

examples.en: The whole village turned out for the festival.
examples.cn: 全村人都出来参加节庆。

examples.en: It took a whole day to clean the attic.
examples.cn: 打扫阁楼花了整整一天。

examples.en: The committee must judge the plan as a whole.
examples.cn: 委员会必须从整体上评判该计划。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「厚」——完整的碗壁摸起来「厚」厚的，一块不缺；而有 hole（洞）的碗壁就「薄」了。

root: whole 源自古英语 hal「完整的、健康的」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hailaz，一般认为出自原始印欧语词根 *kailo-「完整、无伤、吉兆」。同根词有 heal（治愈）、health（健康）、hale（健壮）。中古英语受斯堪的纳维亚语影响拼写添 w-。

sensesIntro.en: From an unbroken circle, whole runs through kept-together things, healthy bodies, the parts' sum, heavy amounts, general views, natural food, and the adverbial swallow.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个不破的圆出发，whole 依次经过未碎之物、健全之躯、部分之和、沉重数量、总体印象、天然食物与囫囵的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bowl with every piece still in place
core.cn: 核心意象：一只每片都还在原位的碗

branches.en: nothing missing and nothing broken
branches.cn: 一块不少，一片未碎

branches.en: the body borrows the bowl's measure
branches.cn: 身体借用碗的度量

branches.en: parts add up to a whole view
branches.cn: 部分累加为整体之见

branches.en: fullness turns into emphasis and the adverb
branches.cn: 圆满转为强调与副词用法

branches.en: unrefined means nothing valuable lost
branches.cn: 未加工即未损失价值

intro.en: Whole extends through native suffixes and keeps its health cousins close.
intro.cn: whole 经本土后缀扩展，并与健康同根词紧密相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cousin salus (health, safety) and integer share the ancient completeness idea.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁表亲 salus（健康、平安）与 integer 共享古老的「完整」观念。

items.meaning: to make parts into a whole

items.meaningCN: 空心的；与 whole 音近义反

whole 派生，义为「有益健康的」

definition_zh: 轮子；车轮；方向盘；轮状物；转动；推动
definition_en: a round object that turns to make vehicles move, or to push something along on wheels
core_image: 绕着轴心不停旋转的圆环，把大地甩向身后
scene: 自行车链条一滑，前轮在沙地里空转了几圈。The front wheel spun uselessly in the loose sand.
sceneCN: 这里 wheel 是名词「轮子」（第 1 个义项：绕轴旋转的圆体）；句意是前轮在松软的沙地里空转。

pos.zh: 轮子；车轮；方向盘；轮状物
转动；推动（带轮之物）；突然转身

collocations.zh: 投机取巧；八面玲珑地交易

derivatives.zh: wheel + chair 复合词，义为「轮椅」
wheel + base 复合词，义为「轴距」
cart + wheel 复合词，义为「（体操）侧手翻；大车轮」
pin + wheel 复合词，义为「风车；纸风车」

senses.title: A round part that turns
senses.definition: a round object that turns around an axle, making a vehicle move
senses.definitionCN: 绕轴旋转的圆体，使车辆行进
senses.example: One wheel of the cart came loose on the stony path.
senses.exampleCN: 石子路上，推车的一只轮子松了。
senses.why: The core mechanical image: a circle turning about its center to carry weight forward.
senses.whyCN: 核心机械意象：绕中心旋转的圆，载着重量向前。

senses.title: The steering wheel of a vehicle
senses.definition: the round control turned by the driver of a car
senses.definitionCN: 司机转动以控制方向的圆盘
senses.example: She kept both hands on the wheel in the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴雨中她双手紧握方向盘。
senses.why: The same circle now steers rather than rolls, but keeps the old name.
senses.whyCN: 同一个圆，从滚动变为转向，仍沿用旧名。

senses.title: Any wheel-shaped object
senses.definition: anything shaped like a wheel, such as a spinning wheel or a firework wheel
senses.definitionCN: 形似轮子的东西，如纺车、转轮烟花
senses.example: A wooden spinning wheel stood in the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 角落里立着一架老式纺车。
senses.why: Shape outlives function: anything round and spoked borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 形状比功能活得更久：任何带辐条的圆物都可借用其名。

senses.title: A cycle of events
senses.definition: a repeating cycle of events or processes
senses.definitionCN: 事件或进程的循环往复
senses.example: The wheels of justice turn slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 正义之轮转得缓慢。
senses.why: A turning circle suggests process that goes round and comes back.
senses.whyCN: 旋转的圆暗示周而复始的进程。

senses.title: To move something on wheels
senses.definition: to push or carry something along on wheels
senses.definitionCN: 推着或用带轮装置运送某物
senses.example: Nurses wheeled the patient down the corridor.
senses.exampleCN: 护士们推着病人穿过走廊。
senses.why: The machine's motion transfers to the person guiding it.
senses.whyCN: 机器的移动转给了操纵它的人。

senses.title: To turn suddenly
senses.definition: to turn around quickly, used of people or animals
senses.definitionCN: 人 or 动物迅速转身
senses.example: The hawk wheeled around and dived.
senses.exampleCN: 鹰骤然盘转身形，俯冲而下。
senses.why: A person turning on the spot traces the same circle as a rolling wheel.
senses.whyCN: 人在原地转身，画出与滚动之轮同样的圆。

senses.title: Circular motion in machines
senses.definition: wheels working together in a machine, as gears or pulleys
senses.definitionCN: 机器中协同工作的轮，如齿轮、滑轮
senses.example: The clock's wheels clicked behind the wooden face.
senses.exampleCN: 木钟面后面，齿轮咔哒作响。
senses.why: One circle drives another, so the word multiplies in machinery.
senses.whyCN: 一个圆带动另一个圆，于是在机械中此词成串出现。

senses.title: Power or organization that keeps things going
senses.definition: the force or system that makes an organization work
senses.definitionCN: 使机构运转的力量或体系
senses.example: Money keeps the wheels of the project turning.
senses.exampleCN: 资金维持着项目的运转。
senses.why: A vehicle's wheels become a metaphor for whatever keeps progress moving.
senses.whyCN: 车轮化作让一切前进的力量之喻。

intro.en: Wheel descends from an ancient root of turning that also gave Greek kyklos, the circle.
intro.cn: wheel 源自一个古老的「转动」词根，希腊语 kyklos（圆）也出自同根。

items.en: The root *kʷekʷlo- is a doubled form of *kʷel- (to turn), generally reconstructed as the source.
items.cn: 一般认为源头是 *kʷel-（转动）的叠音形式 *kʷekʷlo-。

items.en: The form *hwehwlaz carried the meaning of a turning circle.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwehwlaz 意为旋转的圆体。

items.en: Old English hweol or hweogol meant a wheel, still with the hw- sound.
items.cn: 古英语 hweol／hweogol 意为轮子，仍带 hw- 音。

items.en: Spelling shifted to wh- under Norman influence, and the machine sense spread with mills and clocks.
items.cn: 受诺曼影响拼写转为 wh-；水磨与钟表使机械义扩散。

items.en: The verb uses grew: wheeling carts, wheeling around in dance and battle.
items.cn: 十六至十八世纪动词用法增长：推车、转身、队列旋转。

items.en: Automobiles fixed the steering wheel sense, and idiom built wheels of commerce and justice.
items.cn: 汽车时代确立「方向盘」义，习语铸出商业与正义之轮。

note.en: Wheel shares its turning root with cycle and cyclone, and is spelled close to whale and wheezy.
note.cn: wheel 与 cycle、cyclone 共享「转动」词根，拼写又近 whale、wheezy。

abstract.cn: 看鹰在空中慢慢画圈。

abstract.en: Feel the steering wheel tremble in your palms.
abstract.cn: 感受方向盘在掌心的震颤。

examples.cn: 玩具火车掉了一个轮子。
