sensesIntro.en: From the rolling circle, wheel runs to the steering disc, wheel-shaped things, cycles of events, moving and turning, gear trains, and the machinery of progress.

core.cn: 核心意象：绕心旋转的圆，载着世界前行

branches.en: wheels roll alone and work in trains
branches.cn: 轮子既独自滚动，也成系协作

branches.en: the circle turns from rolling to steering

definition_zh: 什么时候；何时；……的时候；那时；既然；尽管
definition_en: at what time; at or during the time that something happens
core_image: 日历上那个还未翻开的日子
scene: 母亲望着门口，等孩子放学回家。When will you be home, she asked every evening.
sceneCN: 这里 when 是疑问副词「什么时候」（第 1 个义项：询问时间）；句意是她每天傍晚都问「你什么时候到家？」。

pos.zh: 那时（用于 since when 等）

derivatives.zh: when + ever，义为「无论何时；每当」
同族时间连词，义为「在……期间；而」
呼应词，义为「那时；然后」

senses.title: At what time (question)
senses.definition: used to ask about the time of an event
senses.definitionCN: 询问事件发生的时间
senses.example: When does the library open on Sundays?
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆周日几点开门？
senses.why: The unknown hour is held out to the listener like an empty date on a calendar.
senses.whyCN: 未知的时刻像日历上一个空着的格子，递给听者去填。

senses.title: At the time that (clause)
senses.definition: at or during the time that something happens
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生之时
senses.example: When the rain stopped, we went out to play.
senses.exampleCN: 雨停了，我们就出去玩。
senses.why: The empty date is filled by the event itself: the clause names the moment.
senses.whyCN: 空格由事件本身填上：从句点出那一刻。

senses.title: Immediately after; as soon as
senses.definition: just after or as soon as something happens
senses.definitionCN: 某事一发生紧接着
senses.example: When she saw the smoke, she dialed 119 at once.
senses.exampleCN: 一看到烟，她立刻拨了 119。
senses.why: Two moments lean so close together that the first seems to cause the second.
senses.whyCN: 两个时刻紧贴在一起，前一个仿佛催生了后一个。

senses.title: Although; while on the contrary
senses.definition: used to introduce a contrast, meaning although or while
senses.definitionCN: 引出对照，义为「虽然、然而」
senses.example: He walks to work when he could easily drive.
senses.exampleCN: 他明明可以开车，却步行上班。
senses.why: The expected time never comes: the contrast fills the empty date instead.
senses.whyCN: 预期的时间并未到来：对照反而占满了那个空格。

senses.title: Since; considering that
senses.definition: used to give a reason, meaning since or considering that
senses.definitionCN: 表示理由，义为「既然」
senses.example: When you are free this afternoon, let's sort the photos.
senses.exampleCN: 既然你下午有空，咱们把照片归整一下吧。
senses.why: A settled fact about time becomes the ground for what follows.
senses.whyCN: 关于时间的既成事实，成为后续安排的依据。

senses.title: At which time (relative use)
senses.definition: referring back to a time just mentioned, in phrases like since when
senses.definitionCN: 回指刚提到的时间，如 since when
senses.example: She joined the firm in 2015, since when sales have doubled.
senses.exampleCN: 她 2015 年加入公司，从那时起销售额翻了一番。
senses.why: The date once filled now anchors everything after it.
senses.whyCN: 已被填上的日期，从此锚定其后的一切。

senses.title: In whatever circumstances
senses.definition: used in set phrases to cover any time, as in when necessary
senses.definitionCN: 用于固定短语，涵盖任何时间，如 when necessary
senses.example: Call me when necessary; I am always here.
senses.exampleCN: 必要时给我打电话，我随时都在。
senses.why: The single word stretches to cover all the dates at once.
senses.whyCN: 一个词被拉长，同时覆盖所有的日子。

senses.title: Say when (polite formula)
senses.definition: used when pouring a drink, telling the guest to say when to stop
senses.definitionCN: 斟饮料时请客人示意「够了」的套语
senses.example: Say when, the host said, filling the glass.
senses.exampleCN: 主人边倒酒边说：够了请说一声。
senses.why: The question becomes a little contract about a stopping point.
senses.whyCN: 疑问变成了关于停止点的契约。

intro.en: When belongs to the ancient hw- question family and was first an instrumental form of the interrogative stem.
intro.cn: when 属古老的 hw- 疑问家族，最初是疑问词干的工具格形式。

items.en: The interrogative stem *kʷo- formed time questions in many branches, generally reconstructed as the source.
items.cn: 一般认为疑问词干 *kʷo- 在多个语支中构成时间疑问词。

items.en: The form *hwan- meant at what time, in questions and clauses alike.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwan- 意为「在何时」，兼用于疑问与从句。

items.en: Old English hwanne or hwænne served both as question word and conjunction.
items.cn: 古英语 hwanne／hwænne 兼任疑问词与连词。

items.en: Spelling became when with the wh- shift, and the contrast sense widened.
items.cn: 拼写随 wh- 转变而定型，对照用法扩宽。

items.en: Fixed phrases like hardly when and say when entered everyday speech.
items.cn: 十六世纪起 hardly when、say when 等固定短语进入日常口语。

items.en: When now runs through questions, clauses, contrasts, reasons, and idioms.
items.cn: 如今 when 贯穿疑问、从句、对照、原因与习语。

note.en: When shares its stem with then and when, and sits beside while in the time-clause family.
note.cn: when 与 then 同族，在时间从句家族中与 while 并肩。

sceneCN: 这里 where 是疑问副词「在哪里」（第 1 个义项：询问地点）；句意是他第三次发问「科学实验室在哪儿？」。

pos.zh: 何处；哪里（用于 where...from 等）

senses.title: In or to what place (question)
senses.definition: used to ask about a place or position
senses.definitionCN: 询问地点或位置
senses.example: Where do the buses stop in this town?
senses.exampleCN: 这个镇上公交车在哪儿停？
senses.why: The pin hovers over the map, asking to be dropped on the right spot.
senses.whyCN: 图钉悬在地图上空，请求落在正确的位置。

senses.title: In or at the place that (clause)
senses.definition: in, at, or to the place that something happens
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生的地点
senses.example: We camped where the river bends.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在河流拐弯处扎营。
senses.why: The place itself answers the question, locking the pin onto the map.
senses.whyCN: 地点本身回答了问题，把图钉按进地图。

senses.title: In what situation or respect
senses.definition: in what situation, respect, or part of a process
senses.definitionCN: 在哪种情形、哪个方面或进程的哪一步
senses.example: This is where patience begins to pay off.
senses.exampleCN: 正是从这里开始，耐心有了回报。
senses.why: A position on the map widens into a position in an argument or a process.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的位置扩展为论证或进程中的位置。

senses.title: The place as a noun clause
senses.definition: the place in which, introducing a clause that works as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 引导名词性从句，义为「……的地方」
senses.example: Show me where it hurts.
senses.exampleCN: 指给我看哪儿疼。
senses.why: The place is packaged and handed over like an object.
senses.whyCN: 地点被打包，像物件一样递交过去。

senses.title: Whereas; while on the other hand
senses.definition: used to introduce a contrast between two facts
senses.definitionCN: 引出两个事实的对比
senses.example: They stayed in the valley, where their cousins climbed the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 他们留在谷地，而表亲们爬上了山脊。
senses.why: Two pins on the map stand apart; the word marks the distance between them.
senses.whyCN: 两枚图钉落在不同处，这个词标记出它们之间的距离。

senses.title: Wherever as universal place
senses.definition: used in set phrases that cover any place, as in where possible
senses.definitionCN: 用于涵盖任何地点的固定短语，如 where possible
senses.example: Reuse old boxes where possible.
senses.exampleCN: 尽可能重复使用旧箱子。
senses.why: One word stretches to cover every pin position at once.
senses.whyCN: 一个词同时覆盖图钉的一切落点。

senses.title: Asking about origin
senses.definition: used with from to ask about origin or source
senses.definitionCN: 与 from 连用，询问来源
senses.example: Where does this old map come from?
senses.exampleCN: 这张旧地图是从哪儿来的？
senses.why: The pin traces a path backward to its starting point.
senses.whyCN: 图钉沿路径回溯到起点。

senses.title: Know where one stands
senses.definition: used in idioms about understanding one's position or status
senses.definitionCN: 用于关于了解自身处境的习语
senses.example: After the meeting, everyone knew where they stood.
senses.exampleCN: 会后，每个人都清楚了自己的处境。
senses.why: A social position borrows the language of a spot on the map.
senses.whyCN: 社会处境借用了地图上位置的语汇。

intro.en: Where is the place-question of the ancient hw- family, built from the same stem as what and when.
intro.cn: where 是古老 hw- 家族的地点疑问词，与 what、when 同出词干。

items.en: The interrogative stem *kʷo- is generally reconstructed as the base of place questions.
items.cn: 一般认为疑问词干 *kʷo- 是地点疑问词的基础。

items.en: The form *hwar meant at what place, cousin to *hwat (what) and *hwan (when).
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwar 意为「在何处」，与 *hwat（what）、*hwan（when）同族。

items.en: Old English hwær served as question word and relative adverb.
items.cn: 古英语 hwær 兼任疑问词与关系副词。

items.en: Spelling settled as where with the wh- scribal change.
items.cn: 拼写随 wh- 书写变革定为 where。

items.en: Compounds like whereby, wherein, and whereof flourished in legal and learned prose.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，whereby、wherein、whereof 在法律与学术散文中盛行。

items.en: Everyday where covers questions, clauses, contrasts, and the famous proverb pair with will.
items.cn: 如今 where 覆盖疑问、从句、对照，并留下与 will 相配的著名谚语。

note.en: Where stands in the hw- question set beside what, when, and why, and forms the sound-twin pair wear where.
note.cn: where 与 what、when、why 同属 hw- 疑问组，又与 wear 构成同音对。

senses.title: In contrast to the first fact
senses.definition: used to compare two things that are different
senses.definitionCN: 用于比较两个不同的事物
senses.example: The north is mountainous, whereas the south is flat farmland.
senses.exampleCN: 北部多山，而南部是平坦的农田。
senses.why: Two facts stand on the two pans of a balance, seen at once.
senses.whyCN: 两个事实被放在天平两端，同时呈现。

senses.title: Opening formal legal documents
senses.definition: used at the start of legal contracts to state background facts
senses.definitionCN: 用于合同开篇陈述背景事实
senses.example: Whereas the parties agreed to cooperate, the contract was signed.
senses.exampleCN: 鉴于双方同意合作，合同得以签署。
senses.why: The weighing word becomes a solemn opener: each fact is laid on the record.
senses.whyCN: 权衡之词变成庄重的开场：每项事实依次入档。

senses.title: Introducing data comparison
senses.definition: used before statistics that differ from the first set
senses.definitionCN: 引出与前面数据不同的统计
senses.example: Sales rose by ten percent, whereas costs fell.
senses.exampleCN: 销售额上升百分之十，而成本下降了。
senses.why: Numbers on opposite pans make the balance visible at a glance.
senses.whyCN: 反向的数字让天平的倾斜一眼可见。

senses.title: Marking an opposite habit or trait
senses.definition: used to contrast habits, traits, or preferences
senses.definitionCN: 对比习惯、特质或偏好
senses.example: He saves every coin, whereas his sister spends freely.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每一枚硬币都存起来，而妹妹花钱大手大脚。
senses.why: Character differences are laid side by side like contrasting figures.
senses.whyCN: 性格差异像对比数字一样被并排放置。

senses.title: Introducing an exception
senses.definition: used to add a case that differs from the general rule
senses.definitionCN: 补充与一般规则不同的情形
senses.example: Most guests stayed overnight, whereas a few left early.
senses.exampleCN: 多数客人留宿，而少数人早早离开。
senses.why: The balance holds a majority on one pan and a minority on the other.
senses.whyCN: 天平一端是多数，另一端是少数。

senses.title: In scientific or report writing
senses.definition: used in academic writing to link contrasting findings
senses.definitionCN: 学术写作中连接相反的发现
senses.example: Group A improved steadily, whereas Group B showed no change.
senses.exampleCN: A 组稳步进步，而 B 组没有变化。
senses.why: Experiments rest on comparison, so the balancing word thrives there.
senses.whyCN: 实验建立在比较之上，权衡之词因而大行其道。

senses.title: Whereas in debate openings
senses.definition: used to open resolutions or petitions with background statements
senses.definitionCN: 用于决议或请愿书开篇的背景陈述
senses.example: Whereas the bridge is unsafe, we ask the council to act.
senses.exampleCN: 鉴于该桥已不安全，我们请求市政会采取行动。
senses.why: Each recorded fact becomes a reason stacked before the request.
senses.whyCN: 每条被记录的事实都成为请求之前码好的一块理由。

senses.title: Whereas in past-time contrast
senses.definition: used to contrast the present with the past
senses.definitionCN: 对比现在与过去
senses.example: Now we send files in seconds, whereas delivery once took weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 如今文件几秒即达，而当年递送动辄数周。
senses.why: Then and now sit on opposite pans of the same balance.
senses.whyCN: 今与昔被放上同一架天平的两端。

intro.en: Whereas grew from the place word where plus as, drifting from place into contrast and law.
intro.cn: whereas 由地点词 where 加 as 生长而来，从「处所」漂移为「对比」与「法律用语」。

items.en: Where and as both descend from ancient Germanic elements of place and manner.
items.cn: where 与 as 都出自古日耳曼语的地点与方式成分。

items.en: The compound meant where or in which place at first, purely local.
items.cn: 复合词起初意为「在哪里」，纯属处所。

items.en: In legal preambles, whereas statements set the facts before the decision.
items.cn: 十五世纪，法律序言中 whereas 陈述先于决定摆出事实。

items.en: The contrast sense spread into ordinary prose beside the legal use.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，对比义随法律用法扩展到普通散文。

items.en: Science and statistics adopted whereas for data comparisons.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪，科学与统计界采用 whereas 做数据对比。

items.en: Today whereas works in daily contrast, academic prose, and legal openings alike.
items.cn: 如今 whereas 兼用于日常对比、学术文体与法律开篇。

note.en: Whereas contrasts with while and although in emphasis, and carries a formal legal flavor.
note.cn: whereas 与 while、although 侧重不同，且带正式的法律色彩。

但是。最口语的对比连词
另一方面。呼应 whereas 的对比功能

normalIntro.en: Whereas is remembered as where plus as and the image of a balance.
normalIntro.cn: 把 whereas 记作 where + as，配合天平意象。

normal.en: where + as: where the first fact stands, as the second differs.
normal.cn: where + as：前一件事立在那里，而另一件不同。

normal.en: whereas clauses open legal contracts.
normal.cn: whereas 条款开法律合同的头。

normal.en: while is softer, whereas is more formal.
normal.cn: while 更口语，whereas 更正式。

normal.en: he runs whereas she walks: both pans visible.
normal.cn: 他跑而她走：两端都看得见。

normal.en: whereas in reports compares numbers.
normal.cn: 报告里 whereas 比较数字。

abstract.en: See two facts resting on opposite pans of a scale.
abstract.cn: 看两个事实躺在天平两端。

abstract.en: Hear a judge reading the preamble aloud.
abstract.cn: 听法官高声宣读序言。

abstract.en: Feel two roads leaving one square in opposite directions.
abstract.cn: 感受两条路从同一广场反向而出。

examples.en: She is tall, whereas her brother is quite short.
examples.cn: 她个子高，而她弟弟相当矮。

examples.en: The old engine was loud, whereas the new one is almost silent.
examples.cn: 旧引擎很吵，而新引擎几乎无声。

examples.en: Whereas the committee approved the budget, it delayed the plan.
examples.cn: 委员会虽批准了预算，却推迟了计划。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维尔阿兹」——维尔和阿兹性格相反：维尔爱静，而阿兹（阿兹爱闹），一个 whereas 拉出对比。

root: whereas 由 where（古英语 hwær「在哪里」，出自原始日耳曼语 *hwar、原始印欧语疑问词干 *kʷo-）加 as（古英语 ealswā 之缩，义为「如同」）复合而成。中古英语本义「在何处」，十五世纪起进入法律序言表「鉴于」，随后衍生「然而」的对比义。

sensesIntro.en: From naming a place, whereas drifted into setting facts on record, weighing contrasts, comparing data, traits, exceptions, findings, resolutions, and eras.
sensesIntro.cn: 从指称处所出发，whereas 依次漂移为事实入档、对比权衡、数据比较、习性对照、例外补充、研究结论、决议序言与今昔对照。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two facts balanced on opposite pans of a scale
core.cn: 核心意象：两个事实被放在天平两端

branches.en: facts and characters lie side by side
branches.cn: 事实与习性被并排摆放

branches.en: numbers and findings make the balance exact
branches.cn: 数字与研究让天平更精确

branches.en: exception and past become the lighter pan
branches.cn: 例外与过去落在较轻的一端

branches.en: recorded facts stack into solemn preambles
branches.cn: 被记录的事实码成庄重的序言

branches.en: traits and findings lie side by side in reports
branches.cn: 报告中的习性与发现被并排摆放

intro.en: Whereas is a compound of two old words, and its family shows other where-compounds.
intro.cn: whereas 是两个古词的复合，其词族展示其他 where 复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin formal counterpart is cum (since, whereas) in legal formulae.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁正式对应词是法律套语中的 cum（既然、鉴于）。

items.meaning: the opening statement of a document

latinEntries.exampleCN: cum 见于法律拉丁套语

where 复合，义为「由此」
where 复合，义为「关于那个」

definition_zh: 是否；无论；不管
definition_en: used to introduce a choice between two possibilities, or to say that the choice does not matter
core_image: 门口的两条路：走左边还是右边，都必须选一个
scene: 老木匠眯眼敲了敲木板，听声音辨干湿。The carpenter tapped the board to hear whether it was dry.
sceneCN: 这里 whether 引导宾语从句「是否」（第 1 个义项：两种可能中取其一）；句意是木匠敲击木板，听听它是否干了。

derivatives.zh: 同族疑问词，义为「哪一个」
呼应词，义为「（两者中）任一的」
近义连词，义为「是否」

senses.title: Asking about a choice inside a sentence
senses.definition: used to report a yes-or-no question inside a statement
senses.definitionCN: 在陈述句中转述一个是非疑问
senses.example: The doctor asked whether the pain had eased.
senses.exampleCN: 医生问疼痛是否减轻了。
senses.why: The open door between yes and no is carried into a longer sentence.
senses.whyCN: 是与不是之间的那扇敞开的门，被搬进了更长的句子里。

senses.title: It does not matter which
senses.definition: used to say that either possibility changes nothing
senses.definitionCN: 表示任一可能性都不改变结果
senses.example: Whether it rains or shines, the match will be played.
senses.exampleCN: 无论下雨还是天晴，比赛照常进行。
senses.why: Both doors stay open, and the plan walks through either one.
senses.whyCN: 两扇门都开着，计划从哪扇走进都一样。

senses.title: Before an infinitive
senses.definition: used before to and a verb, showing a decision to make
senses.definitionCN: 用于不定式前，表示待做的抉择
senses.example: She could not decide whether to accept the offer.
senses.exampleCN: 她无法决定是否接受那份提议。
senses.why: The two roads shrink into two words: to do or not to do.
senses.whyCN: 两条路缩成两个词：做，还是不做。

senses.title: After prepositions
senses.definition: used after prepositions where if is not allowed
senses.definitionCN: 用于介词之后（此时不可用 if）
senses.example: The result depends on whether we start early.
senses.exampleCN: 结果取决于我们是否及早开始。
senses.why: Some grammatical gates admit only whether, keeping the fork intact.
senses.whyCN: 某些语法之门只放 whether 通过，以保住那个岔路口。

senses.title: Two contrasting possibilities
senses.definition: used with or to weigh two opposite possibilities
senses.definitionCN: 与 or 连用，权衡两种相反的可能
senses.example: Whether he forgot or refused, the effect was the same.
senses.exampleCN: 无论他是忘了还是拒绝，结果都一样。
senses.why: The two pans of the choice are named in turn before the balance settles.
senses.whyCN: 天平的两端被逐一叫出名字，然后才见分晓。

senses.title: Whether by design or chance
senses.definition: used in fixed phrases that accept both causes at once
senses.definitionCN: 固定短语中同时接纳两种成因
senses.example: Whether by design or chance, the two events met.
senses.exampleCN: 无论有意还是巧合，两件事撞在了一起。
senses.why: Cause itself is put on the fork: either way, the fact stands.
senses.whyCN: 连成因也被放上岔路口：无论如何，事实成立。

senses.title: Formal reporting of alternatives
senses.definition: used in formal writing to report alternatives precisely
senses.definitionCN: 正式文体中精确转述备选项
senses.example: The report questions whether the data were complete.
senses.exampleCN: 报告质疑数据是否完整。
senses.why: Formal prose prefers the heavier word to keep the fork explicit.
senses.whyCN: 正式文体偏爱较重的词，让岔路口保持显形。

senses.title: Whether or no as emphasis
senses.definition: used in the old phrase whether or no, meaning in any case
senses.definitionCN: 古语短语 whether or no，义为「不管怎样」
senses.example: Whether or no, the ship sailed at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 不管怎样，船在黎明起航了。
senses.why: Saying both answers aloud closes the question forever.
senses.whyCN: 把两个答案都喊出口，问题就此永远关闭。

intro.en: Whether descends from an old word meaning which of two, built from the same stem as which.
intro.cn: whether 源自一个意为「两个中哪一个」的古词，与 which 同出词干。

items.en: The interrogative stem *kʷo- is generally reconstructed as the shared source.
items.cn: 一般认为共同的源头是疑问词干 *kʷo-。

items.en: The form *hwaithar meant which of the two, with the comparative ending -ther.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwaithar 意为「两者中的哪一个」，带比较级式词尾 -ther。

items.en: Old English hwæther meant which of two, also each of two.
items.cn: 古英语 hwæther 意为「两者中的哪一个」，也指「两者各自」。

items.en: Spelling became whether, and the conjunction use overtook the pronoun use.
items.cn: 拼写定为 whether，连词用法超过了代词用法。

items.en: Whether or no flourished in drama and the Bible, fixing the emphatic use.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪 whether or no 盛行于戏剧与钦定本圣经，确立了强调用法。

items.en: Whether now handles indirect questions, concessives, infinitives, and formal reports.
items.cn: 如今 whether 承担间接疑问、让步、不定式与正式转述。

note.en: Whether is twin to which in the old two-choice system and overlaps with if in reporting questions.
note.cn: whether 与 which 在古老的二选一体系中是孪生，转述疑问时又与 if 交叠。

entries.definition: the state of the air, such as rain or sun
entries.definitionCN: 天气。与 whether 同音异源，最著名的混淆对

entries.definition: asking about one from a set
entries.definitionCN: 哪一个。与 whether 同出「二选一」词根

entries.definition: one or the other of two
entries.definitionCN: 任一。与 whether 同属二选一词族
阉羊（罕用词）。第三个同音词，务必区分
然而。wh- 家族的对比连词
是否。口语常用，介词后与不定式前不可用

entries.definitionCN: 与否。whether or not 为完整搭配
不顾；不管。whether 义的副词说法
无论是否。whether 让步义的加强说法

normalIntro.en: Whether is remembered through the weather pair and the two-door image.
normalIntro.cn: 通过与 weather 的同音对和两扇门的意象来记 whether。

normal.en: whether has an h: ask whether; weather has an a: rain and air.
normal.cn: whether 中有 h 表疑问；weather 中有 a 表天气。

normal.en: whether or not: both doors named.
normal.cn: whether or not：两扇门都被点名。

normal.en: whether to go: the fork before the verb.
normal.cn: whether to go：动词前的岔路口。

normal.en: which of two was the old meaning.
normal.cn: 古义就是「两个中哪个」。

normal.en: whether it rains or shines, we start.
normal.cn: 无论晴雨，我们都出发。

abstract.en: See two doors standing open at the end of one hall.
abstract.cn: 看长廊尽头两扇敞开的门。

abstract.en: Feel a coin flipping that lands both ways at once.
abstract.cn: 感受一枚同时两面朝上的硬币。

abstract.en: Hear rain on the roof while the match goes on.
abstract.cn: 听屋顶雨声，比赛照常进行。

examples.en: I wonder whether she remembers our promise.
examples.cn: 不知她是否还记得我们的约定。

examples.en: Whether you agree or not, the deadline stays.
examples.cn: 无论你同意与否，截止日期不变。

examples.en: The choice is whether to wait or to walk.
examples.cn: 选择是等还是走。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维泽尔」——维尔在岔路口问「维泽尔（为这个）还是为那个？」二选一时默念 whether。

root: whether 源自古英语 hwæther「两者中的哪一个」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hwaithar（疑问词干 *hwa- 加表二选一的比较级式后缀 -ther），一般认为最终出自原始印欧语疑问词干 *kʷo-。同族词 which、either。中古英语连词用法取代古义「两者各自」。

sensesIntro.en: From choosing one of two, whether runs through reported questions, indifferent outcomes, infinitive forks, prepositional gates, weighed alternatives, set phrases, formal reports, and the old emphatic close.
sensesIntro.cn: 从二选一出发，whether 依次经过转述疑问、无差别的结果、不定式岔路、介词之门、权衡的备选、固定短语、正式转述与古老的强调收束。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two open doors at the end of one hall
core.cn: 核心意象：长廊尽头两扇敞开的门

branches.en: the fork is carried into reports, casual and formal
branches.cn: 岔路口被搬进转述，口语与正式皆可

branches.en: both doors stay open and nothing changes
branches.cn: 两扇门都敞开，结果不变

branches.en: the fork shrinks to to do or not to do
branches.cn: 岔路缩为「做还是不做」

branches.en: some gates admit only this word
branches.cn: 有些语法之门只容此词通行

branches.en: naming both pans settles the balance
branches.cn: 叫出两端之名，天平落定

intro.en: Whether carries an ancient comparative ending inside it and keeps its two-choice cousins near.
intro.cn: whether 内部携带古老的比较级式词尾，并与二选一近亲为伴。

latinIntro.en: The Latin two-choice word uter shares the old comparative pattern.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁二选一词 uter 共享古老的比较级模式。

items.meaning: not one and not the other

items.exampleCN: uter 派生 uterque（两者各自）

latinEntries.example: uter, as in uterque (each of two)

definition_zh: 哪一个；哪些；那个；哪些（引导从句）；（非限定）这个
definition_en: asking about or pointing to one or more from a known set
core_image: 货架上排成一列的同款物品，手在上面逐一点过
scene: 柜台上摆着三把同样的伞，客人犹豫不决。Which umbrella is yours among the three?
sceneCN: 这里 which 是疑问限定词「哪一个」（第 1 个义项：已知范围内选取）；句意是三把伞中哪一把是你的？

derivatives.zh: which + ever，义为「无论哪个」
同族疑问词，义为「什么」（范围未知）
近义关系词，义为「那个」（限定从句）

senses.title: Asking about one from a known set
senses.definition: used to ask about one or more from a limited, known group
senses.definitionCN: 在已知、有限的一组中询问哪个
senses.example: Which train goes to the airport?
senses.exampleCN: 哪一班火车去机场？
senses.why: The items are already laid out; only the pointing finger moves.
senses.whyCN: 物品已排列就绪，只有手指在移动指认。

senses.title: Referring back to a thing in a clause
senses.definition: used to connect a clause to a thing just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 把从句连到刚提到的事物上
senses.example: The book which I borrowed is due tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我借的那本书明天到期。
senses.why: The finger points backward to nail the already-named thing.
senses.whyCN: 手指向后一指，钉住那个已被命名的事物。

senses.title: Adding extra information in a clause
senses.definition: used after a comma to add information about the whole statement
senses.definitionCN: 逗号后补充说明整句话
senses.example: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他考试通过了，这让所有人都吃了一惊。
senses.why: The pointing finger sweeps back to take in the whole scene.
senses.whyCN: 手指回扫，把整个场面一并圈住。

senses.title: Which of, choosing within a group
senses.definition: used with of to limit the choice to a named group
senses.definitionCN: 与 of 连用，把选择限定在指明的组内
senses.example: Which of these paintings do you like best?
senses.exampleCN: 这些画里你最喜欢哪一幅？
senses.why: The shelf is named first, then the finger travels along it.
senses.whyCN: 先报出货架，手指再沿货架滑过。

senses.title: Which is why, marking a result
senses.definition: used to connect a statement to its consequence
senses.definitionCN: 把陈述与其结果相连
senses.example: The bridge was icy, which is why we walked slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 桥面结了冰，所以我们走得很慢。
senses.why: The clause reaches back and lifts the whole cause into view.
senses.whyCN: 从句回身一捞，把整个原因托到眼前。

senses.title: Which way, asking about direction
senses.definition: used to ask about a route or side
senses.definitionCN: 询问路线或方向
senses.example: Which way did the rabbit run?
senses.exampleCN: 兔子往哪边跑了？
senses.why: The known set is the map itself; the finger points along it.
senses.whyCN: 已知的集合就是地图本身，手指沿图一指。

senses.title: In formal preposition phrases
senses.definition: used after prepositions in formal writing, as in in which
senses.definitionCN: 正式文体中介词后接 which，如 in which
senses.example: The house in which she was born still stands.
senses.exampleCN: 她出生的那座房子依然矗立。
senses.why: Formal style keeps the pointing finger and the carrier together.
senses.whyCN: 正式文体让手指和它的载具形影不离。

senses.title: Every which way, in all directions
senses.definition: used in the idiom every which way, meaning in all directions
senses.definitionCN: 习语 every which way，义为「四面八方、乱作一团」
senses.example: The wind blew the papers every which way.
senses.exampleCN: 风把文件吹得四处乱飞。
senses.why: The pointing finger spins until it points everywhere at once.
senses.whyCN: 手指打起转来，一时指向所有方向。

intro.en: Which is the old two-choice question word of Germanic, cousin to whether and either.
intro.cn: which 是日耳曼古老的二选一疑问词，与 whether、either 是表亲。

items.en: The interrogative stem *kʷo- is generally reconstructed as the source of the set.
items.cn: 一般认为整个疑问词族的源头是词干 *kʷo-。

items.en: The form *hwatilaz or *hwilikaz meant what kind of, which of them.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwatilaz／*hwilikaz 意为「何种、其中哪个」。

items.en: Old English hwilc meant which, working as pronoun and adjective.
items.cn: 古英语 hwilc 意为「哪个」，兼任代词与形容词。

items.en: Spelling became which; the relative use expanded strongly.
items.cn: 拼写定为 which；关系代词用法大幅扩展。

items.en: Formal strings like in which and of which flourished in scholarly prose.
items.cn: 十六至十八世纪，in which、of which 在学术散文中盛行。

items.en: Which now covers questions, restrictive and non-restrictive clauses, and idioms.
items.cn: 如今 which 覆盖疑问、限定与非限定从句及习语。

note.en: Which is bounded by a known set, unlike what, and overlaps with that in defining clauses.
note.cn: which 以已知集合为界，不同于 what；在限定从句中又与 that 交叠。

normalIntro.cn: 通过 which-witch 同音对和指认的手来记 which。

normal.en: which one? witch, no; which, yes.
normal.cn: 问哪个用 which，不是 witch（女巫）。

normal.en: which needs a known list; what does not.
normal.cn: which 需要已知清单，what 不需要。

normal.en: which is why connects cause to result.
normal.cn: which is why 把原因连向结果。

normal.en: in which, of which: formal writing pairs.
normal.cn: in which、of which：正式写作的固定搭配。

normal.en: every which way means every direction.
normal.cn: every which way 指四面八方。

abstract.en: See a hand moving slowly along a row of cups.
abstract.cn: 看一只手沿一排杯子缓缓移过。

abstract.en: Hear a witch cackle while you choose, to tell them apart.
abstract.cn: 选择时听女巫咯咯笑，记住二者区别。

abstract.en: Feel the finger tap the right item twice.
abstract.cn: 感受手指在正确物品上轻点两下。

examples.en: Which color do you prefer, red or blue?
examples.cn: 红色和蓝色，你更喜欢哪个？

examples.en: The song, which she wrote herself, became a hit.
examples.cn: 这首歌是她自己写的，后来大受欢迎。

examples.en: He missed the bus, which made him late again.
examples.cn: 他没赶上公交，结果又迟到了。

root: which 源自古英语 hwilc「哪个、何种」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hwilikaz（疑问词干 *hwa- 加 -likaz「样式」类后缀），一般认为最终出自原始印欧语词干 *kʷo-。同族词 whether、either。关系代词用法在中古英语及以后大为扩展。

core.cn: 核心意象：一只手沿一排已知选项逐一点过

branches.en: selection inside a set, a group, or a map
branches.cn: 在集合、组群与地图内选取

branches.en: the finger nails things backward, formally or not
branches.cn: 手指向后钉住事物，正式与否皆可

branches.en: the whole scene or cause is lifted for comment
branches.cn: 整个场面或原因被托起评论

branches.en: the pointing hand spins to all directions
branches.cn: 指认之手打转，指向四方

branches.en: the same hand both links back and turns round
branches.cn: 同一只手既向后回指又原地打转

intro.cn: which 与 ever 复合，并接介词构成正式词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin question word qui (which, who) is the cross-language cousin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁疑问词 qui（哪个、谁）是其跨语言表亲。

a tree of which the roots are deep

definition_zh: 当……的时候；而（对比）；虽然；一段时间
definition_en: during the time that; whereas; although; a period of time
core_image: 一根平放的长条：它既是时间的一段，也是两条路线之间的那条中线
scene: 厨房里汤在慢慢炖，他趁机擦净了灶台。He wiped the stove while the soup was cooking.
sceneCN: 这里 while 是连词「当……的时候」（第 1 个义项：同时进行的两件事）；句意是汤在炖的时候，他擦了灶台。

同时；其间，义为「在此期间」
片刻，义为「短时间地」

senses.title: During the time that
senses.definition: during the time that something is happening
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生期间
senses.example: The phone rang while she was in the shower.
senses.exampleCN: 电话在她洗澡时响了。
senses.why: Two events share one stretch of the strip of time.
senses.whyCN: 两件事共用同一段时间的长条。

senses.title: Whereas
senses.definition: used to contrast two different facts
senses.definitionCN: 用于对比两个不同的事实
senses.example: He likes tea, while his sister prefers coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 他喜欢茶，而他妹妹偏爱咖啡。
senses.why: The strip runs between two routes, marking how they differ.
senses.whyCN: 那条长条横在两条路线之间，标出它们的差异。

senses.title: Although
senses.definition: used to admit something that weakens the main point
senses.definitionCN: 先承认某事，再提出主要论点
senses.example: While I understand your plan, I still have doubts.
senses.exampleCN: 虽然我理解你的计划，但我仍有疑虑。
senses.why: The two routes never meet; both are kept on the map.
senses.whyCN: 两条路线永不相交，但都被留在图上。

senses.title: A period of time
senses.definition: a period of time, especially a short one
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间，尤指较短的一段
senses.example: We waited for a while before the door opened.
senses.exampleCN: 我们等了一会儿，门才开。
senses.why: The strip is cut off and handed over as a small piece.
senses.whyCN: 时间之条被截下一段，作为小块交到手里。

senses.title: Spend time pleasantly
senses.definition: used in while away, to pass time in a relaxed way
senses.definitionCN: 用于 while away，指轻松地打发时间
senses.example: They whiled away the hours with cards and stories.
senses.exampleCN: 他们靠打牌和讲故事消磨时光。
senses.why: The piece of time is worn thin by gentle use.
senses.whyCN: 那一小段时间被轻轻磨薄，不知不觉就用完了。

senses.title: Once in a while
senses.definition: used in once in a while, meaning occasionally
senses.definitionCN: 用于 once in a while，表示偶尔
senses.example: Once in a while, she takes the long road home.
senses.exampleCN: 偶尔，她会绕远路回家。
senses.why: A thin slice of time appears only now and then.
senses.whyCN: 薄薄一片时间，只在偶尔的时刻出现。

senses.title: Meanwhile in narration
senses.definition: used in stories to move to what happens at the same time elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 叙事中切换到别处同时发生的事
senses.example: While the city slept, the ships slipped out to sea.
senses.exampleCN: 当城市沉睡时，船只悄然出海。
senses.why: The strip stretches over two places at once.
senses.whyCN: 时间之条同时罩住两个地方。

senses.title: It will be worth your while
senses.definition: used in worth your while, meaning the effort will pay off
senses.definitionCN: 用于 worth your while，表示付出会有回报
senses.example: It is worth your while to check the price first.
senses.exampleCN: 先比比价是值得的。
senses.why: The piece of time is traded for a return.
senses.whyCN: 那一小段时间被换来一份回报。

intro.en: While comes from an old word for time, a span that can be measured or lived through.
intro.cn: while 源自一个表示「时间」的古词，指一段可以度量或度过的时光。

items.en: The root *kʷeih₂- meant to rest, to lie quiet, and gave words for time and rest.
items.cn: 词根 *kʷeih₂- 意为「安卧、歇息」，衍生出表示时间与安息的词。

items.en: The form *hwīlō meant a span of time, a while.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwīlō 意为「一段时间」。

items.en: Old English hwīl meant time, space of time; Latin requies and quiet share the root.
items.cn: 古英语 hwīl 意为「时间」；拉丁语 requies、quiet 与之同根。

items.en: Spelling settled as while, and the conjunction senses grew alongside the noun.
items.cn: 拼写定为 while，连词义随名词义一同发展。

items.en: The contrast sense (whereas) and the concessive sense (although) became established in prose.
items.cn: 十六至十八世纪，对比义与让步义在书面语中确立。

items.en: While now serves time, contrast, concession, and idioms like once in a while.
items.cn: 如今 while 承担时间、对比、让步及 once in a while 等习语。

note.en: While overlaps with when in timing, with whereas in contrast, and is formally dressed as whilst.
note.cn: while 在时间义上与 when 交叠，在对比义上与 whereas 相近，正式变体则是 whilst。

整个的。形近易混，w-h 与 wh-开头有别

然而。 whereas 对比义更强、更正式

normalIntro.en: While is remembered through the time strip and the two-routes image.
normalIntro.cn: 通过时间之条与两条路线的意象来记 while。

normal.en: while the soup cooks: same stretch of time.
normal.cn: while the soup cooks：共用一段时间的长条。

normal.en: he likes tea, while she likes coffee: the strip lies between.
normal.cn: 他爱茶，而她爱咖啡：长条横在两人之间。

normal.en: for a while: one small piece of the strip.
normal.cn: for a while：长条上截下的一小块。

normal.en: once in a while: a thin slice, now and then.
normal.cn: once in a while：薄薄一片，偶尔出现。

normal.en: whilst is while wearing a suit.
normal.cn: whilst 是穿上正装的 while。

abstract.en: See a long flat ruler of time lying across a table.
abstract.cn: 看一根平放的时间长尺横在桌上。

abstract.en: Feel two roads running side by side, separated by one thin line.
abstract.cn: 感受两条并行的路，被一条细线隔开。

abstract.en: Hear soup bubbling while hands wipe the stove.
abstract.cn: 听汤咕嘟作响，同时手在擦灶台。

examples.en: She hummed while she worked in the garden.
examples.cn: 她在花园里干活时哼着歌。

examples.en: While the plan looks bold, the risks are real.
examples.cn: 虽然计划显得大胆，风险却是真实的。

examples.en: Stay here for a while; I will be back soon.
examples.cn: 在这儿待一会儿，我很快就回来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「歪哦」——时间条被你掰歪了一小段：歪哦（while），就这么歪着过了一会儿。

root: while 源自古英语 hwīl「时间、一段时间」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hwīlō（「停留的一段时光」），一般认为最终出自原始印欧语词根 *kʷeih₂-（「安卧、歇息」），与拉丁语 quies（安息）、quiet（安静的）同根。名词义「一段时间」最古，连词义（当……时、而、虽然）由时间义引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: From a span of time, while stretches into simultaneity, contrast, concession, small pieces of time, pastime, rarity, narration, and fair trades of effort.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一段时间出发，while 依次延伸为同时、对比、让步、时间小片、消遣、偶尔、并叙与值得的付出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long flat strip of time lying between two events
core.cn: 核心意象：一根平放的时间长条，横躺在两件事之间

branches.en: one strip of time is shared by two events or two places
branches.cn: 一根时间之条被两件事或两地共用

branches.en: the strip becomes a line between two routes or admits both
branches.cn: 长条化为两路之间的分界线，或同时容纳两说

branches.en: small pieces cut from the strip, some rare
branches.cn: 从长条上截下的小块，有的只是偶尔出现

branches.en: the piece of time is worn thin by gentle use
branches.cn: 那一小段时间被轻轻磨薄

branches.en: the piece of time is traded for a return
branches.cn: 那一小段时间被换来回报

intro.en: While builds compounds about time and keeps its formal variant and cousins nearby.
intro.cn: while 构成与时间相关的复合词，并带着正式变体与同根词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root quies (rest) shares the old Indo-European source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 quies（安息）与 while 共享古老的印欧源头。

definition_zh: 白色的；白种人的；（茶的）加奶的；雪白之物；白人
definition_en: having the colour of snow or milk; completely pale; a person with pale skin; the colour white
core_image: 一片新雪覆盖大地，万物只剩下干净的亮白
scene: 清晨推窗，屋顶和街道全被新雪盖住。The whole town turned white after the snow.
sceneCN: 这里 white 是形容词「白色的」（第 1 个义项：雪或奶的颜色）；句意是雪后全镇变成了白色。

derivatives.zh: white 动词化，义为「变白；使变白」
white + -ish，义为「带白色的；发白的」
white + wash，义为「白涂料；粉饰」

senses.title: The colour of snow or milk
senses.definition: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
senses.definitionCN: 具有新雪或牛奶的颜色
senses.example: She wore a white dress to the summer party.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿一条白裙去参加夏日聚会。
senses.why: The fresh snow covers every other colour completely.
senses.whyCN: 新雪把其他颜色全部盖住，只留下纯净的白。

senses.title: Pale from fear or illness
senses.definition: very pale, especially because of fear or sickness
senses.definitionCN: （因恐惧或生病而）脸色惨白
senses.example: His face went white when he heard the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到消息，他的脸一下子白了。
senses.why: The colour drains away, leaving the white of bare paper.
senses.whyCN: 颜色被抽走，只剩下白纸般的空白。

senses.title: With milk added
senses.definition: used of tea or coffee with milk in it
senses.definitionCN: 指加奶的茶或咖啡
senses.example: White coffee, no sugar, please.
senses.exampleCN: 请给我加奶咖啡，不加糖。
senses.why: Milk pours its pale colour into the dark cup.
senses.whyCN: 牛奶把自己淡淡的白色倒进深色的杯中。

senses.title: Pure or clean
senses.definition: used of things considered pure, clean, or innocent
senses.definitionCN: 用于象征纯洁、洁净或无辜之物
senses.example: The bride wore white, an old sign of purity.
senses.exampleCN: 新娘一身白色，这是纯洁的老象征。
senses.why: The untouched snow has no mark of dirt upon it.
senses.whyCN: 未踩过的新雪上没有一个污点。

senses.title: A white lie
senses.definition: used in a white lie, a small untruth told to be kind
senses.definitionCN: 用于 a white lie，指为避免伤人而说的小谎
senses.example: He told a white lie to spare her feelings.
senses.exampleCN: 他撒了个善意的谎言，免得她难过。
senses.why: The lie is washed clean, like snow over mud.
senses.whyCN: 谎言像雪盖住泥泞，被洗得干净。

senses.title: The white of an egg or eye
senses.definition: the clear part of an egg or of the eye that turns white when cooked or shown
senses.definitionCN: 蛋清（熟后变白）或眼球的白色部分
senses.example: Beat the whites of two eggs until stiff.
senses.exampleCN: 把两个蛋清打到发硬。
senses.why: Heat or light reveals the pale part inside.
senses.whyCN: 加热或展露，让内部淡白的部分显现。

senses.title: Relating to people with pale skin
senses.definition: belonging to the group of people with pale skin
senses.definitionCN: 属于肤色浅的人群体
senses.example: The survey asked people to describe their background.
senses.exampleCN: 调查请人们描述自己的族裔背景。（其中 white 为常用分类词）
senses.why: The colour name becomes a neutral label in lists and forms.
senses.whyCN: 颜色之名在清单与表格里成了中性的标签。

senses.title: In black and white
senses.definition: used in in black and white, meaning written down clearly
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in black and white，指白纸黑字写明
senses.example: I want the deal in black and white before we start.
senses.exampleCN: 开工之前，我要白纸黑字的协议。
senses.why: Dark ink on pale paper leaves the clearest record.
senses.whyCN: 深色墨水落在淡白纸面，留下最清楚的记录。

intro.en: White comes from an old word for shining and bright, later fixed to the palest colour.
intro.cn: white 源自一个表示「发亮、闪耀」的古词，后来专指最淡的颜色。

items.en: The root *kʷeitos meant bright, shining; Welsh gwyn (white, blessed) keeps it.
items.cn: 词根 *kʷeitos 意为「明亮、闪耀」；威尔士语 gwyn（白、受祝福的）保留此根。

items.en: The form *hwītaz meant bright, then white.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwītaz 意为「明亮的」，进而指「白色的」。

items.en: Old English hwīt meant white, bright; the rune for it was named for snow.
items.cn: 古英语 hwīt 意为「白的、亮的」；对应的如尼字母即以雪命名。

items.en: Spelling settled as white, and the purity symbolism grew in customs and heraldry.
items.cn: 拼写定为 white，纯洁的象征义在习俗与纹章中发展。

items.en: White coffee, white lie, and in black and white entered everyday speech.
items.cn: 十六至十九世纪 white coffee、white lie、in black and white 进入日常用语。

items.en: White now names a colour, a paleness, milk-drink customs, and social categories.
items.cn: 如今 white 指颜色、苍白、加奶习惯及社会分类用语。

note.en: White pairs with black as opposites, trips over wheat and whet in sound, and hosts a colour family of pale words.
note.cn: white 与 black 互为反义，发音上与 wheat、whet 易混，并统领一众「淡白」近义词。

磨（刀）；激发。与 white 音近易混

一点点（用于 not a whit）。与 white 拼写相近
机智。与 white 拼写相近，注意有无 e

entries.definition: light in colour, less than usual

normalIntro.en: White is remembered through the fresh-snow cover and the bright old root.
normalIntro.cn: 通过新雪覆盖与「明亮」古词根来记 white。

normal.en: white means bright long ago, then snow-white.
normal.cn: white 古义是「明亮」，后来专指雪白。

normal.en: a white lie is washed clean like snow.
normal.cn: a white lie 像被雪洗过一样干净。

normal.en: white coffee: milk lightens the cup.
normal.cn: white coffee：牛奶让杯子变浅。

normal.en: in black and white: ink on pale paper.
normal.cn: in black and white：白纸黑字。

normal.en: not a whit: one tiny crumb of white.
normal.cn: not a whit：一点点白色碎屑都没有。

abstract.en: See snow falling until every roof turns the same pale shade.
abstract.cn: 看雪落下，直到每个屋顶变成同一种浅白。

abstract.en: Feel milk swirling into dark tea, the dark dissolving.
abstract.cn: 感受牛奶旋入深茶，深色渐渐化开。

abstract.en: Hear the hush of a town muffled by fresh snow.
abstract.cn: 听新雪把整座小镇压得静悄悄。

examples.en: The walls were painted white to make the room feel larger.
examples.cn: 墙壁刷成白色，让房间显得更大。

examples.en: Her knuckles turned white as she gripped the rail.
examples.cn: 她紧握栏杆，指节都变白了。

examples.en: Please put the promise in black and white.

root: white 源自古英语 hwīt「白的、明亮的」，可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *hwītaz，一般认为最终出自原始印欧语词根 *kʷeitos（「明亮、闪耀」），与威尔士语 gwyn（白、纯洁）同根。语义从「发亮」收窄为「纯白」，并衍生出苍白、加奶、纯洁、书面明示等引申义。

sensesIntro.en: From shining brightness, white narrows to snow colour, drains to paleness, stirs in milk, rises to purity, softens into kind lies, reveals egg and eye, labels backgrounds, and seals promises on paper.
sensesIntro.cn: 从明亮的闪耀出发，white 收窄为雪色，褪成苍白，调入奶白，升为纯洁，软化成善意谎言，显出蛋白与眼白，标注族裔背景，并把承诺封进纸面。

senses.title: Asking which person
senses.definition: used to ask about the name or identity of a person
senses.definitionCN: 询问人的名字或身份
senses.example: Who left the window open last night?
senses.exampleCN: 昨晚是谁没关窗户？
senses.why: The hand rises over the crowd, asking for a name.
senses.whyCN: 那只手在人群上空举起，要一个名字。

senses.title: Linking a person to a clause
senses.definition: used to join a person to a following clause about them
senses.definitionCN: 把人与关于他的从句连接起来
senses.example: The nurse who helped me works night shifts.
senses.exampleCN: 帮助过我的那位护士上夜班。
senses.why: The pointing finger stays on the person and adds their story.
senses.whyCN: 指认的手停在那个人身上，补出他的故事。

senses.title: In questions about worth
senses.definition: used in questions like who cares, showing that nobody does
senses.definitionCN: 用于 who cares 之类问句，表示「没人在乎」
senses.example: Who cares about the old rules now?
senses.exampleCN: 如今谁还在乎那些老规矩？
senses.why: The question is asked, and the crowd stays silent.
senses.whyCN: 问题喊了出去，人群却一片沉默。

senses.title: Who knows as uncertainty
senses.definition: used in who knows, meaning the future is uncertain
senses.definitionCN: 用于 who knows，表示前途未卜
senses.example: Will the shop survive? Who knows.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店能撑下去吗？谁知道呢。
senses.why: The finger points everywhere because no name can be found.
senses.whyCN: 手指四处指去，因为找不到那个名字。

senses.title: Introducing a name
senses.definition: used to give a person's name or role after it is asked
senses.definitionCN: 在问过之后给出名字或身份
senses.example: This is Anna, who joined us in May.
senses.exampleCN: 这位是安娜，五月份加入我们。
senses.why: The finger settles on one face and names it.
senses.whyCN: 手指落在一张脸上，报出名字。

senses.title: Whoever: any person at all
senses.definition: used in whoever, meaning any person, it does not matter
senses.definitionCN: 用于 whoever，指任何人都可以、无所谓是谁
senses.example: Whoever finishes first gets the prize.
senses.exampleCN: 谁先完成谁拿奖。
senses.why: The hand sweeps across the whole crowd at once.
senses.whyCN: 那只手一下子扫过整个人群。

senses.title: Formal whom as object
senses.definition: whom, the object form, appears in formal writing
senses.definitionCN: 宾格 whom 出现在正式文体中
senses.example: The guest whom we invited arrived early.
senses.exampleCN: 我们邀请的那位客人早早就到了。
senses.why: In formal halls, the finger is dressed in its best clothes.
senses.whyCN: 在正式的厅堂里，指认之手换上了正装。

senses.title: Who is who in a set
senses.definition: used in who is who, meaning which person has which role
senses.definitionCN: 用于 who is who，指分清各人的身份角色
senses.example: In the photo, it is hard to tell who is who.
senses.exampleCN: 照片里很难分清谁是谁。
senses.why: Many fingers rise together, each waiting for a name.
senses.whyCN: 许多只手一起举起，各自等着被点名。

intro.en: Who comes from the ancient question word for which person, shared across the Germanic family.
intro.cn: who 源自古老的「哪个人」疑问词，为日耳曼语族所共享。

items.en: The stem *kʷo- formed the question words of many old languages.
items.cn: 词干 *kʷo- 构成许多古老语言的疑问词。

items.en: The form *hwaz meant who, with forms for whom and whose already alongside.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 *hwaz 意为「谁」，whom、whose 的形式早已并存。

items.en: Old English hwā meant who; hwæm (whom) and hwæs (whose) served the other cases.
items.cn: 古英语 hwā 意为「谁」；hwæm（whom）与 hwæs（whose）承担其他格。

items.en: The hw- spelling turned to wh- under Norman writing habits, giving who, whom, whose.
items.cn: 在诺曼书写习惯下 hw- 变为 wh-，形成 who、whom、whose。

items.en: Who grew into the standard relative pronoun for people, and whom held its formal seat.
items.cn: 十五至十八世纪，who 成为指人的标准关系代词，whom 保有正式席位。

items.en: Who now asks and links freely in speech, while whom survives in formal use.
items.cn: 如今 who 在口语中自由发问与连接，whom 仅存于正式用法。

note.en: Who stands in the ancient hw- question family beside what and which, and its object form whom is fading in speech.
note.cn: who 与 what、which 同属古老的 hw- 疑问家族，其宾格 whom 在口语中日渐式微。
